blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis:
blocks.zh: 温室项目代表了我们对一个简单论文的探索:

blocks.en: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,只有有限的计算资源,才有可能建立完全开放和主权的代理搜索模式。

blocks.en:
This report describes our first project milestone.
As the headline result, we show that it is possible to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets.
Most notably, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones to initialize our reranker, which has been the dominant approach described in the literature.
Models that we pre-trained ourselves from publicly available raw corpora appear to be sufficient to produce competitive rerankers after supervised fine-tuning using a publicly available dataset.
Our training recipe currently does not require synthetic data or teacher-provided knowledge from any third-party sources (proprietary or open-weight).
Thus, we retain full control over all dependencies in the entire training pipeline, from end to end.
Furthermore, we were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using only a handful of GPUs, making it feasible for others to reproduce our results.

最值得注意的是,我们不依靠现有的开放量级骨干来初始化我们的再排名,这是文献中描述的主导方法.
我们从公开的原始公司中预选的模型,似乎足以在使用公开的数据集进行监督的微调后产生具有竞争力的重新排名。

blocks.en: 2 Toward Agentic Search
blocks.zh: 2 面向代理搜索

blocks.en:
Given our thesis, it makes sense to be more precise about what we mean by ‘‘agentic search’’.
Stripping away unhelpful anthropomorphization and deliberate attempts at making things sound more complicated than they actually are, agents are simply models using tools in loops.
Anthropic engineers characterize agents as ‘‘LLMs using tools based on environmental feedback in a loop’’. 1 1 1 https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents In modern parlance, the “thing” that does the “looping” is typically referred to as the harness.
The harness invokes the model, executes tool calls, returns their results, and maintains the context needed to continue (as well as participating in the decision to stop when the user task is complete).
blocks.zh:
考虑到我们的论文,更确切地说我们所说的“代理搜索”是有意义的。
脱去无益的人类形态化 以及故意使事情变得比实际的复杂 代理只是使用循环工具的模型
Anthropic工程师将代理人定性为“LLMs”,使用基于环流环境反馈的工具。 在现代术语中,“打炮”的“东西”通常被称作“用管子”。
牵引装置会引用模型,执行工具调用,返回结果,并保持继续(以及参与在用户任务完成后停止的决定)所需的上下文.

blocks.en: 2.1 Scoping Our Efforts
blocks.zh: 2.1 界定我们的努力

blocks.en:
Thus, agentic search is simply agents doing “searchy stuff”.
For these applications, models use “search tools” in loops, broadly defined to include, for example, grep, BM25, dense vector search, external APIs that perform live web search, etc.
Of course, agentic search can involve non-search tools as well, for example, to read a retrieved document, to execute an analysis, or to capture intermediate findings.
Typically, a model would decompose a complex information need into smaller components, and for each, the model might issue a query, examine retrieved results, identify missing information, and follow up with reformulated queries.
In many cases, the model is also responsible for synthesizing relevant information into a coherent whole that addresses the user’s information need.
Our definition is intentionally broad to encompass the information-seeking aspects of a variety of downstream tasks, from automated data science to writing detailed research reports.
blocks.zh:
因此,代理搜索只是从事“搜索”的特工。
对于这些应用,模型在回路中使用"搜索工具",广义定义包括例如grep,BM25,密集矢量搜索,进行活网络搜索的外部API等.
当然,代理搜索也可以涉及非搜索工具,例如读取检索到的文档,执行分析,或获取中间结果等.
典型的情况是,一个模型将把复杂的信息需求分解成更小的组件,对于每个组件,该模型可以发出查询,检查检索的结果,找出缺失的信息,并对重新拟订的查询采取后续行动。
在许多情况下,该模型还负责将有关信息合成一个连贯的整体,满足用户的信息需要。
我们的定义有意宽泛,以涵盖从自动化数据科学到编写详细研究报告等各种下游任务的信息搜索方面。

blocks.en:
Since agentic search covers quite a bit of ground, we are cognizant of the need to appropriately scope our efforts.
We focus only on information seeking: finding, assessing, and synthesizing information from a variety of (possibly heterogeneous) sources in response to a user request.
To be clear, we are not attempting to build a general-purpose frontier model;
for example, coding and general reasoning are outside our immediate scope.
It would be unreasonable to organize our research around competing directly with frontier labs across the full range of capabilities they pursue.
Instead, we believe that a deliberately scoped effort can yield useful, measurable advances while contributing to knowledge in a rigorous fashion.
For us, the focus is on agentic search using fully open and sovereign models.
blocks.zh:
由于代理搜索覆盖了相当多地方,我们认识到有必要适当扩大我们的努力范围。
我们只注重寻找信息:应用户请求,从各种(可能各不相同)来源寻找、评估和综合信息。
很明显,我们没有试图建立一个通用前沿模式;
例如,编码和一般推理不属于我们眼前的范围。
组织我们的研究 直接与前沿实验室竞争 是不合情理的
相反,我们认为,蓄意扩大范围的努力可以产生有益和可衡量的进展,同时严格地促进知识。
对我们来说,重点是利用完全开放和主权模式进行代理搜索。

blocks.en:
Our conception of agentic search does not prescribe a particular system architecture.
An information-seeking task might be handled by a single (powerful) model driven by a simple harness, or by multiple agents that explore different sources in parallel and coordinate autonomously to exchange findings.
A tool call can be as simple as a system command (e.g., grep ), a REST API invocation, or may itself be a composite system involving LLMs (e.g., BM25 search followed by LLM-based reranking).
These alternatives represent design choices to be explored empirically.
blocks.zh:
我们的代理搜索概念并没有规定一个特定的系统架构.
寻找信息的任务可以由一个单一的(强大的)模型处理,由简单的绳子驱动,或者由多个代理人同时探索不同的来源并自主协调以交换调查结果。
一个工具调用可以像一个系统命令(例如grep),一个REST API引用,或者本身可能是一个涉及LLMs的复合系统(例如BM25搜索,然后LLM重排).
这些替代方案代表了有待实证探讨的设计选择。

blocks.en:
While our ultimate goal is to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search in its entirety, our approach emphasizes incremental progress: building useful components, rigorously understanding their behavior and limitations under controlled conditions, and composing them into increasingly capable systems.
Achieving full openness and sovereignty while maintaining output quality is an unrealistic goal at the outset: instead, initial systems are likely to be hybrids that integrate both proprietary and open components—for example, a proprietary frontier model coordinator that synthesizes relevant information while delegating searches to fully open and sovereign models.
Consistent with our core thesis, we seek to make individual components fully open and sovereign so that others can inspect their development, reproduce our experiments, and build on the results.
Over time, we hope to gradually expand our scope to encompass more and more of agentic search.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的最终目标是建立完全开放和主权的模式,以进行整体的代理搜索,但我们的方法强调渐进式的进展:建立有用的组件,严格了解它们在控制条件下的行为和限制,并将其形成日益能干的系统。
在保持产出质量的同时实现充分开放和主权,从一开始就是一个不现实的目标:相反,最初的系统很可能是混合体,既融合专有部分,又融合开放部分,例如,一个专有前沿模式协调员,负责综合相关信息,同时将搜索权下放到完全开放和主权模式。
根据我们的核心理论,我们力求使各个组成部分完全开放和主权,以便其他人能够检查其发展、复制我们的实验并在此基础上更上一层楼。
随着时间的推移,我们希望逐步扩大我们的范围,以包括越来越多的代理搜索。

blocks.en: 2.2 Pointwise Reranking
blocks.zh: 2.2 酌情重新排序

blocks.en:
Against this backdrop, our first project milestone—that we have successfully accomplished, as described in this report—focuses on a decoder-only pointwise reranker.
While rerankers are quite common today, let us be precise about the problem we are tackling, building on the definition of text retrieval (ranking) from Lin (2021) :

虽然今天重新排行榜相当普遍,但让我们确切地了解我们所处理的问题,

These metrics vary, but they all aim to quantify the “goodness” of the results with respect to the information need; in some cases, metrics can be understood more formally in terms of the utility that a user would derive from consuming the results.
The retrieval task is also called top- k k retrieval (or ranking), where k k is the length of the ranked list (also known as the retrieval or ranking depth).

A pointwise reranker accomplishes this one ( q , d n ) (q,d_{n}) pair at a time, where q q is the query and d n d_{n} is a document returned by top- k k retrieval above, n ∈ { 1 ​ … ​ k } n\in\{1\ldots k\} .
For every such pair, which is considered in isolation independently, the reranker generates a score s n s_{n} , i.e., ℛ ⁡ ( q , d n ) = s n \mathcal{R}(q,d_{n})=s_{n} , such that sorting by these scores produces a permutation of the input ranked list that is intended to increase the metric of interest. 3 3 3 Note that pointwise rerankers are often contrasted with pairwise rerankers that consume pairs of documents and listwise rankers that consume lists of documents. Our initial project milestone focuses on pointwise reranking, but we hope to build other types of rerankers as part of future work. See additional discussion in Section 2.3 .

blocks.en:
In this report, we describe a fully open and sovereign decoder-only LLM for pointwise reranking that achieves a level of effectiveness competitive with alternatives reported in the literature built on open-weight models.
Beyond model checkpoints, we share all artifacts (data, code, configurations) that are necessary to reproduce our work, end to end.
blocks.zh:
在本报告中,我们描述了一种完全开放的、只有主权的解码器的LLM,这种解码器用于点定重排,从而达到与基于开量模型的文献中所报告的替代品相竞争的效能水平。
除了模范检查站,我们分享所有复制我们的工作、结束和结束所必需的文物(数据、代码、配置)。

blocks.en: 2.3 Why Pointwise Reranking?
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 为什么要重新排队?

blocks.en:
A natural next question: Why start with a pointwise reranker as the first project milestone?
We provide three answers:
blocks.zh:
一个自然的问题: 为什么从一个有分寸的重新排名开始作为第一个项目里程碑?
我们提供了三个答案:

blocks.en:
Velocity is an important consideration in our project, and a pointwise reranker enables rapid iteration during model development.
At inference time, the reranker is simply a function that maps a query–document pair ( q , d ) (q,d) to a scalar score.
Each candidate can be scored independently, and the resulting scores determine the ranking.
This gives us a simple interface for training and evaluation, allowing us to isolate the effects of changes to training data, training recipes, model architectures, configurations, etc.
blocks.zh:
速度是我们项目中一个重要的考虑因素,一个有分寸的再排位法使得在模型开发期间能够快速迭代.
在推论时间,再排档只是将查询-文档对(q,d) (q,d)映射到分数的函数.
每个候选人都可以独立得分,由此得分决定排名.
这给了我们一个简单的培训与评估的界面,使我们能够隔离培训数据,培训食谱,模型架构,配置等变化的效果.

blocks.en:
With pointwise rerankers, we can evaluate model checkpoints on a fixed set of candidate documents without processing the entire corpus each time.
Compared to pairwise ( Pradeep et al., 2021 ) and listwise ( Pradeep et al., 2023a ; Pradeep et al., 2023b ) variants, pointwise rerankers are easier to build because there are fewer design choices to explore.
With respect to other reasonable options as a first project milestone, we considered but did not pursue training embedding models, which typically involve much more effort.
Assessing the quality of an updated model usually requires recomputing embeddings for the entire corpus before evaluating top- k k retrieval.
For large collections, this additional step can substantially slow the development cycle.
We feel that training agentic search models is even less appropriate as a first step, as such efforts involve substantial complexity, including generating and evaluating multi-step trajectories and, depending on the approach, collecting rollouts to feed reinforcement learning.
In the end, we targeted pointwise reranking, which gives us a more tightly scoped experimental setting with fewer interacting components.
We believe that it is a simple but useful capability that can provide an interesting existence proof for our core thesis.
blocks.zh:
有了分明的重新排名,我们可以评估一套固定的候选文件上的示范检查站,而不必每次处理整个清单。
相较于配对(Pradeep等,2021年)和列表(Pradeep等,2023a;Pradeep等,2023b)等变体,指向后排列器更容易被构建,因为可供探索的设计选择较少.
关于作为第一个项目里程碑的其他合理备选办法,我们考虑但没有采用培训嵌入模式,这通常需要付出更多的努力。
评估更新模型的质量通常需要在整个元件中重新计算嵌入物,然后才能评价顶-克-克检索.
对大型收藏而言,这一额外步骤可大大地减缓开发周期。
我们认为,培训代理搜索模式作为第一步更不合适,因为这种努力涉及相当复杂的问题,包括产生和评价多步骤的轨迹,并视方法而定,收集推广材料,为强化学习提供素材。
最后,我们定点重排, 这使得我们有一个范围更紧密的实验环境, 互动组件更少。
我们认为,这是一个简单而有用的能力,可以为我们的核心论点提供有趣的存在证据。

blocks.en:
A reranker is useful as a standalone component in a broader retrieval pipeline.
It can be applied to candidate documents generated by any number of approaches: BM25, a dense retrieval model, an external search API, or a hybrid of these.
Reranking can be especially helpful in cases where one does not have direct access to the raw corpus, such as when searching via a web API.
In all cases, the interface remains the same: given a query and a list of candidate documents, score each pair and reorder the candidates.
The design makes it possible to incorporate a reranker into an existing system with minimal effort.
blocks.zh:
重新排序器作为更广泛的检索管道中的独立组成部分是有用的。
它可以被应用到任意几个方法产生的候选文件:BM25,密集检索模型,外部搜索API,或者这些方法的混合.
在无法直接接触原始实体的情况下,如在通过网络API搜索时,重新排序尤其有帮助。
在所有情况下,界面都保持不变:给出查询和候选文件列表,每对对分并重新排列候选者.
这种设计使得尽可能不费力地将重新排名者纳入现有系统。

blocks.en:
The modularity of rerankers is particularly attractive for agentic search.
At each iteration, a search tool may return more content than the agent can reasonably inspect.
A reranker can help prioritize which results to read or include in the model’s context.
This means that a reranker can be inserted into an agentic search application at multiple points, thus increasing its applicability.
blocks.zh:
重新排名的模块化对于代理搜索特别有吸引力.
每次重复时,搜索工具返回的内容可能比代理商能够合理检查的内容多.
重新排序者可以帮助确定哪些结果可以读取或包含在模型的背景中。
这意味着可以在多点处将重排器插入代理搜索应用程序,从而提高其可适用性.

blocks.en:
The existence of commercial reranking services provides further evidence that this is a useful capability in its own right.
Examples include Microsoft’s semantic ranker in Azure AI Search, 4 4 4 https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/semantic-search-overview Google Cloud’s Ranking API, 5 5 5 https://docs.cloud.google.com/generative-ai-app-builder/docs/ranking NVIDIA’s NeMo Retriever Reranking NIM, 6 6 6 https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/nemo-retriever/reranking/latest/overview.html and dedicated APIs from Cohere, 7 7 7 https://docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/rerank Voyage AI, 8 8 8 https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/reranker and Jina AI. 9 9 9 https://jina.ai/en-US/reranker/ These offerings span hosted APIs, integrated search services, and deployable inference microservices, illustrating the utility of reranking across different retrieval architectures.
The recent release of the Jev ‘‘decision model’’ 10 10 10 https://typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev further confirms the utility of reranking as an important independent capability: although the model was designed for structured outputs in general, reranking has emerged as a popular use case.
blocks.zh:
商业重组服务的存在进一步证明,这本身就是一种有用的能力。
例如:微软在Azure AI Search中的语义排行榜,4 4 4 https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/semantic-search-overview Google Cloud's Ranking API, 5 5 5 https://docs.cloud.google.com/generative-ai-app-buildinger/docs/ squad. NVIDIA的"NeMo Retriever release NIM",6 6 6 6 https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/nemo-retriever/relequence/latest/overview.html 和 Cohere的专用API,7 7 7 https://docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/rerank Voyage AI, 8 8 8 https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/rerancker和Jina AI. 9 9 https://jina.ai/en-US/rerancker/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21. 这些服务覆盖了API、综合搜索服务和可部署的推论微服务,说明了在不同检索结构中重新排序的效用。
最近发布的Jev-决定模型__10 10 https://typesafe.ai/blog/introductioning-system-one-models-和-jev进一步证实了重新排位作为一种重要独立能力的效用:虽然该模型一般是为了结构化的产出而设计的,但重新排位已经成为一种受欢迎的使用案例。

blocks.en:
A reranker is also an important stepping stone towards more sophisticated models for agentic search.
Beyond ordering results at inference time to prioritize what is fed to the model (as discussed above), a reranker can be used to assess relevance, i.e., used as an LLM judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Upadhyay et al., 2024 ; Upadhyay et al., 2025 ) .
A pointwise reranker ℛ ⁡ ( q , d n ) = s n \mathcal{R}(q,d_{n})=s_{n} , if properly calibrated, can provide scores that estimate the probability of relevance, i.e., s n ≈ P ⁡ ( y n = 1 ∣ q , d n ) s_{n}\approx P(y_{n}=1\mid q,d_{n}) , where y n y_{n} denotes binary relevance.
For search agents, a good relevance judge might be a helpful capability when inspecting retrieved results, particularly in cases where they only have access to “weak” tools such as grep ( Li et al., 2026 ) or BM25 search ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
重新排行榜也是向更精密的代理搜索模型迈进的重要踏脚石.
除了在推论时对提供给模型的内容进行优先排序(如上所讨论)外,还可以使用重新排名法评估相关性,即用作LLM法官(郑等,2023;Upadhyay等,2024;Upadhyay等,2025)。
分级调整的R Q (q, d n) = s n\ mathcal{R} (q, d_{n}) = s_{n},如果校准得当,可以提供估计相关概率的分数,即 s n ≈ P ⁡ (y n = 1 ∣ q, d nn) s_{n 相近 P (y_{n}= 1\mid q, d_{n}),其中 y n_{n 表示二进制相关.
对于搜索人员而言,在检查检索结果时,特别是当他们只能使用Grep(Li等,2026年)或BM25搜索(Hsu等,2026年)等“弱”工具时,一个具有良好相关性的法官可能是有用的能力。

blocks.en:
Modern search agents can be trained with reinforcement learning to acquire search policies ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) , and relevance scores can contribute to reward signals by providing feedback on the relevance of the material retrieved by their actions ( Mao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
Alternatively, a relevance judge could be used as a component of a verifier to assess the quality of rollouts as part of rejection sampling ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026b ) .
There are many possibilities, and it is not difficult to see how a reranker could serve as an important component in agentic search, either at training time or inference time.
blocks.zh:
现代搜索人员可接受强化学习培训以获得搜索政策( Zhu等,2025; Jin等,2025;相關分數可提供对其行动所取出材料相关性的回馈,为奖励信号出力( Mao等,2024;李等,2025.
或者,可使用相关法官作为核查员的组成部分,作为拒绝抽样的一部分评估推出的质量(Wu等,2025;Luo等,2026b)。
可能性很多,在训练时间或推论时间,重新排名者如何作为代理搜索的重要组成部分并不难.

blocks.en:
To be clear, this report captures our present findings within a larger effort.
Beyond pointwise reranking, we have plans to build models for listwise reranking, query reformulation, relevance feedback, steering search trajectories, etc. towards full agentic search.
A reranker is a good first milestone that provides an existence proof of one initial aspect of our broader vision.
Our reranking model is of immediate utility and provides a stepping stone for subsequent research.
blocks.zh:
简言之,本报告在更大范围内总结了我们目前的调查结果。
超越分点再排位之外,我们还有计划为列表再排位,查询重排,相关性反馈,引导搜索轨迹等建立模型,以向全代理搜索.
重新排行榜是一个良好的第一个里程碑,它为我们更广泛的愿景的一个初步方面提供了存在的证据。
我们的重排模式具有即时作用,为随后的研究提供了踏脚石。

blocks.en: 3 Fully Open and Sovereign Models
blocks.zh: 3 完全开放和主权模式

blocks.en: Next, let us precisely define what we mean by fully open and sovereign models.
blocks.zh: 接着,让我们精确地界定我们所谓的完全开放和主权模式。

blocks.en: 3.1 LLM Training as Hypergraphs
blocks.zh: 3.1 LLM(低压) 培训为超图

blocks.en:
Abstractly, we can model LLM training as a directed property hypergraph 𝒢 = ( V , E ) \mathcal{G}=(V,E) where the vertices ( V V ) represent artifacts (for example, a raw corpus, training examples, model weights, etc.) and the edges ( E E ) represent computations (including training recipes and associated configuration data) that consume upstream artifacts to generate downstream artifacts.
Following standard notation, a (directed) hyperedge e ∈ E e\in E is formally an ordered pair ( T e , H e ) (T_{e},H_{e}) , where T e , H e ⊆ V T_{e},H_{e}\subseteq V , commonly written as T e ⟶ H e T_{e}\longrightarrow H_{e} .
A hyperedge describes a computation, and we can think of an edge traversal as someone running that computation.
Traversing an edge that already exists can be viewed as a reproducibility attempt.

抽象地说,我们可以将LLM训练作为定向属性高图G = (V, E)\ mathcal{ (V, E),其中顶点(V, V)代表了文物(例如生体,培训实例,模型权重等),边缘(E E)代表了消耗上游文物生成下游文物的计算(包括培训秘方和相关配置数据).

一个超极地描述一个计算, 我们可以想象一个边缘的转折, 是一个运行这个计算的人。
穿越已经存在的边缘可被视为可复制尝试.

blocks.en:
In this directed hypergraph representation, both vertices and hyperedges are annotated with properties in the form of arbitrary key–value pairs.
One simple possibility is that a vertex is annotated with the Hugging Face dataset that captures the artifact and a hyperedge is annotated with a command invocation identified by a commit id in a particular GitHub repo.
Both vertices and edges might be associated with publications.
Each hyperedge might be further annotated with compute requirements, for example, quantifying the approximate number of GPU hours that an edge traversal will require.
blocks.zh:
在这个定向的超正图表示中,顶点和超正弦都以任意键-值对的形式附加属性.
一个简单的可能性是,一个顶点被附加了捕捉该文物的Hugging Face数据集的注释,一个超接头被附加了一个命令引用,由特定GitHub repo中的承诺id识别出.
顶点和边缘都可能与出版物有关。
每个超接地可能用计算要求作进一步说明,例如,量化边缘转动所需的大约GPU时数。

blocks.en:
For example, pre-training starts from a raw corpus of texts T 1 = { 𝒞 1 } T_{1}=\{\mathcal{C}_{1}\} to produce pre-trained model weights H 1 = { ℳ 1 } H_{1}=\{\mathcal{M}_{1}\} via e 1 e_{1} , a pre-training recipe (Section 5 ).
With appropriate property annotations, it would be possible for someone with sufficient compute resources to reproduce model pre-training, i.e., to traverse T 1 ⟶ H 1 T_{1}\longrightarrow H_{1} .
In this example, we assume that the pre-training recipe associated with e 1 e_{1} includes not only the actual source code but also all relevant configuration data.

有了适当的财产说明,就可以由有足够计算资源的人复制模型预训,即穿越T 1 Q X H 1 T X X X 右上角 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你觉得呢?
在这个例子中,我们假设,与e 1 e_{1}相关的培训前配方不仅包括实际源代码,而且还包括所有相关的配置数据.

blocks.en:
Hyperedges provide a natural representation to capture other aspects of LLM training because they allow multiple tail vertices.
For example, a fine-tuning hyperedge e 2 e_{2} might start from a pre-trained backbone and some training set ( T 2 = { ℳ 1 , 𝒮 1 } T_{2}=\{\mathcal{M}_{1},\mathcal{S}_{1}\} ) to produce model weights H 2 = { ℳ 2 } H_{2}=\{\mathcal{M}_{2}\} via a particular fine-tuning recipe (Section 6 ).
In principle, the head vertex set can contain multiple elements as well, representing more than one output artifact.
blocks.zh:
Hyperedges为捕捉LLM训练的其他方面提供了自然的体现,因为它们允许多个尾椎.
例如,微调超接力 e 2 e _{2 } 可能从一个预先训练过的骨干和一些训练集(T 2 = {M 1, S 1 } T _{2}=\{\ mathcal{M}_{1},\ mathcal{S}_{1}\}})开始,通过特定的微调配方(第6节)来产生模型重 H 2 = {M 2 } H_{2}=\{\ mathcal{M}_{2}\} } .
原则上,头顶集也可以包含多个元素,代表多个输出文物.

blocks.en: Definition: Given a hypergraph representation of model training, we define a fully open and sovereign model as a vertex (model weights) where all upstream vertices and edges are publicly available and do not contain proprietary dependencies.
blocks.zh: 定义:鉴于模型训练的多写法,我们把一个完全开放和主权的模型定义为顶点(模型权重),所有上游顶点和边缘都公开提供,并不包含专有依赖性.

blocks.en: In other words, a model is fully open and sovereign if and only if it is possible to independently derive the model weights from a set of publicly available sources via computational steps (represented by edge traversals) that are also captured in public artifacts.
blocks.zh: 换句话说,一个模型是完全开放和主权的,条件是并且只有在有可能通过计算步骤(由边缘曲面代表)从一套公开来源中独立得出模型的权重,这些方法也是在公共文物中捕获的.

blocks.en:
Of course, the tracing of upstream sources must “stop” somewhere, because otherwise it is easy to arrive at absurdities.
For example, a standard pre-training corpus (e.g., FineWeb-Edu or ClimbMix) lies downstream of potentially complex processes that generated it.
These include stages that involve web crawling, curation, cleaning, parsing, etc., and the texts ultimately derive from a multitude of authors on the web.
It would be impractical to trace LLM training all the way back to these authors.
Similarly, standard training datasets (e.g., MS MARCO) are the output of some annotation process (in this case, by Microsoft).
As we trace sources upstream, where this process “ends” necessarily involves making some judgment calls, which we indeed do, based on commonly accepted datasets in the field.
For example, we consider starting with the ClimbMix corpus or the MS MARCO dataset fully open and sovereign, given their widespread availability and familiarity among researchers.
blocks.zh:
当然,对上游来源的追踪必须“停止”,否则很容易产生荒谬之处。
例如,一个标准的培训前程序(如FineWeb-Edu或ClimpMix)位于产生它的潜在复杂过程下游.
其中包括涉及网络爬行,校正,清扫,解析等阶段,文本最终出自网络上众多作者.
追踪LLM训练到这些作者身上是不切实际的。
同样地,标准培训数据集(如MS MARCO)是一些注释过程(在此情况下由微软)的输出.
在我们追踪上游来源时,这一进程的“结束”必然涉及作出一些判断性呼吁,我们确实这样做了,这种判断性呼吁是基于实地普遍接受的数据集。
例如,我们考虑从ClimpMixtocus或MS MARCO数据集开始,因为这些数据集是完全开放和主权的,因为研究人员可以广泛获得和熟悉。

blocks.en:
Based on our definition, any model that is derived from open weights, but whose pre-training corpus and pre-training recipes are unavailable, does not qualify as being fully open and sovereign.
While open-weight models are undoubtedly useful and provide high-quality backbones for subsequent fine-tuning, our work shows that they are not necessary to produce a competitive reranker.
In Section 8 , we discuss related work with respect to our definitions.
blocks.zh:
根据我们的定义,任何来自开放重量的模型,如果其培训前和培训前的食谱没有,则不符合完全开放和主权的条件。
虽然开放量级模型无疑是有用的,为后续的微调提供了高品质的骨干,但我们的研究表明,它们对于产生具有竞争力的再排名来说是不必要的.
在第8节中,我们讨论与我们的定义有关的工作。

blocks.en: 3.2 The LLM Training Ecosystem
blocks.zh: 3.2 LLM 培训生态系统

blocks.en:
The directed hypergraph representation of model training proposed above provides a precise way to capture provenance: a model can be characterized as a specific traversal of the training hypergraph, with intermediate artifacts captured along the way.
Such a representation can help a group of collaborating researchers more accurately track ablations and contrastive conditions.
A data ablation can be thought of as a hyperedge with fewer tail vertices.
A code ablation or an alternative training recipe can be thought of as different hyperedges with the same tail vertices.
blocks.zh:
上文提议的模型训练的定向超正图表现提供了准确的捕捉出处的方法:一个模型可以被定性为训练超正图的特定横道,中间的文物沿途被捕捉.
这种代表性可以帮助一组合作研究人员更准确地跟踪各种变化和反差状况。
数据衰竭可以被看作尾椎较少的多指尖.
代码衰减或另类训练食谱可被视作有同一种尾椎的不同的超高缘.

blocks.en:
We can extend this representation of LLM training beyond a single research group to characterize the entire ecosystem comprised of a multitude of researchers around the world working in a distributed fashion.
All that would be needed is a common machine-readable encoding of the representation proposed here and some method of aggregating such representations across many researchers.
With such a characterization of the field, we could, for example, trace all models that are fine-tuned versions of a particular Qwen backbone, or all models that have used MS MARCO or BEIR.
Some of this information is already captured in Hugging Face metadata, but we can imagine an agent semi-automatically enriching the ecosystem description by scanning the latest literature to extract vertex and hyperedge information.
blocks.zh:
我们可以将这种LLM培训的表述范围扩大到一个单一的研究小组之外,以描述由世界各地众多研究人员组成的整个生态系统。
所需要的只是对这里提议的表述作一个共同的机器可读编码,以及将许多研究人员的表述汇总起来的一些方法。
有了这样的场面特征,我们就可以,比如,追踪所有对特定Quen骨干进行微调版本的模型,或者所有使用过MS MARCO或BEIR的模型.
其中一些信息已经在Hugging Face元数据中被捕捉到,但我们可以想象一种代理半自动地通过扫描最新的文献来提取顶点和超尖端信息来丰富生态系统描述.

blocks.en:
This representation could support agents that identify unexplored combinations of artifacts and recipes, propose new experiments, and execute feasible candidates subject to resource and evaluation constraints.
We could further close the loop with automatic evaluation harnesses and give agents autonomy in “growing” the hypergraph according to some high-level goal.
This might provide a concrete substrate for automated AI scientists or for recursive self improvement within a narrowly specified scope.
blocks.zh:
这种代表性可以支持物剂查明未探索的文物和食谱的组合,提出新的试验建议,并在资源和评价限制下执行可行的候选人。
我们可以进一步用自动评估工具来关闭循环,并根据一些高级别目标,在“增加”高频图方面给予特工自主权。
这可能为自动化AI科学家提供具体的基底,或在狭义规定的范围内进行递归自我改进。

blocks.en: 3.3 Other Considerations
blocks.zh: 3.3 其他考虑

blocks.en:
Viewing model training as traversing hyperedges from tails to heads does not necessarily mean that we have exhaustively traversed every edge ourselves .
Furthermore, it also does not necessarily mean that a specific hyperedge traversal is guaranteed to be “successful” (more discussion below).
It is important to untangle questions about openness and sovereignty (the first) from questions about reproducibility (the second), which are orthogonal.
blocks.zh:
把模型训练看成从尾巴到头的超接力,
此外,这也不一定意味着保证特定的超接力转弯“成功”(下文将作进一步讨论)。
必须将关于开放和主权的问题(第一个)同可复制性问题(第二个)分开,后者是正统的。

blocks.en:
Openness and sovereignty focus on the availability of resources (data, code, etc.) to transform one artifact into another.
Whether the data and recipes “work as advertised” is a (different) question of reproducibility.
They are completely independent.
To see why, consider the hypothetical case in which an organization shares its data and code with another under a non-disclosure agreement.
In this case, the results may be reproducible (by the second organization), but not open since the data and code are not publicly available.
blocks.zh:
开放性和主权性注重资源(数据,代码等)的可获性,将一个文物转化为另一个文物.
数据和配方是否“按广告工作”是一个(不同的)可复制性问题。
他们完全独立。
要了解原因,请考虑一个组织根据不披露协议与另一个组织共享数据和代码的假设情况。
在这种情况下,结果可能是可复制的(由第二个组织),但因数据和代码不公开而不能公开.

blocks.en:
The success of a specific hyperedge traversal is a question of reproducibility, and in this work we make judgment calls.
As a specific example, in one set of experiments we start with a model checkpoint shared by Andrej Karpathy, which he asserts as having been pre-trained on a particular dataset with code in a specific repo.
Although we have not actually run his code from the dataset, we trust that his complete recipe works as claimed.
That is, we have not independently verified reproducibility, but in this case, we feel that trust is warranted.
blocks.zh:
一种特定的超尖端转盘的成功是一个可复制性的问题,在这项工作中,我们作出判断。
作为具体的例子,在一组实验中,我们首先从安德烈·卡纳森(Andrej Karopathy)共享的模型检查点开始,他声称这个模型在某个特定的数据集上接受了预先的训练,在特定的回波中有代码.
虽然我们没有从数据集中实际运行他的代码,但我们相信他完全的食谱如所声称的那样有效.
也就是说,我们没有独立核实的可复制性,但在这种情况下,我们感到有必要信任。

blocks.en:
Similarly, readers of our report or those wishing to use our results do not necessarily need to traverse every hyperedge themselves.
Instead, they can take advantage of any vertex along a traversal (i.e., directly use the model weights or any intermediate artifacts).
As discussed above, whether a particular code repository accurately reflects the putative hyperedge is a question of reproducibility.
Someone can indeed “trust us”, for example, that our claimed approach to fine-tuning does indeed yield a particular level of effectiveness on benchmark datasets, or not trust our claims and try out the method independently (i.e., a reproduction attempt).
This is possible since by our definition every vertex and hyperedge must be publicly available.
Thus, a fully open and sovereign ecosystem is maximally flexible.
Anyone can take advantage of an artifact directly (i.e., download model weights and perform inference) or trace an artifact upstream to rerun the experiments that generated it.
In an open ecosystem, anyone can consider alternatives by branching off another hyperedge and sharing the resulting artifacts, which represents a discrete contribution to our collective knowledge.
blocks.zh:
同样,我们的报告的读者或希望利用我们的成果的读者也不一定需要跨越每一个尖端。
相反,它们可以利用沿曲面(即直接使用模型重量或任何中间文物)的任何顶点.
如上所讨论,某个特定的代码存储器是否准确反映假想的超接头是一个可复制性问题.
例如,有人确实可以“信任我们”,我们所声称的微调方法确实在基准数据集方面产生了一定的有效性,或者不相信我们的说法,并独立地尝试这一方法(即复制尝试)。
这一点是有可能的,因为根据我们的定义,每个顶点和顶点都必须公开。
因此,一个完全开放和主权的生态系统具有最大的灵活性。
任何人都可以直接利用一件文物(即下载模型重量并进行推论),或者追踪上游的一件文物来重新运行产生它的实验.
在一个开放的生态系统中,任何人都可以考虑其他办法,从另一个超高地分出,分享由此产生的文物,这是对我们集体知识的一个单独贡献。

blocks.en:
In the ideal case, repeated traversals of the same hyperedge should yield identical results.
This is a realistic assumption for deterministic transformations.
However, we expect that, in many cases, repeated traversals of the same hyperedge yield “substantively” similar, but not necessarily identical, results.
blocks.zh:
在理想的情况下,同一超接力的反复穿行应产生相同的结果。
这是确定性转变的现实假设。
然而,我们期望,在许多情况下,同样的超尖端产出的反复转折“实质上”产生类似但不一定完全相同的结果。

blocks.en:
For model training, even with the same inputs, code, configuration, random seed, etc., unavoidable differences in hardware, software environments, and nondeterministic operations in training will likely lead to different model weights (see explorations in Section 6.2 ).
Thus, our notion of reproducibility does not require output artifacts to be byte-wise identical. 11 11 11 As Codex likes to say. Strictly speaking, multiple hyperedge traversals are unlikely to produce the same exact output artifact(s); vertices in our LLM training hypergraph thus capture the output of a specific execution instance.
blocks.zh:
对于模型训练,即使有相同的输入,代码,配置,随机种子等,在硬件,软件环境以及培训中非决定性操作方面不可避免的差异,也可能导致不同的模型权重(见第6.2节的探索).
因此,我们的可复制性概念并不要求产出文物按字节表示相同。 严格地说,多个超尖端转盘不太可能产生相同的精确输出文物;我们的LLM训练超高分图中的顶点从而捕捉出特定执行实例的输出.

blocks.en:
Instead, we adopt a more “relaxed” assumption about reproducibility.
Accepting that byte-identical artifacts are unlikely, rerunning a computation should nevertheless reproduce its associated experimental claims substantively, for example, comparable effectiveness on the reported benchmarks, within a reasonable range of variation.
Our use of vague weasel terms such as “substantive”, “reasonable”, etc. is deliberate, as we will need to exercise judgment, but the community will ultimately assess the veracity of our claims.
Along the way, we will adopt commonly accepted standards, such as quantifying effectiveness variations through multiple trials and referencing existing evaluations already documented in the literature.
Ultimately, the public availability of all artifacts (vertices) and code (hyperedges) makes third-party audits of our claims possible.
blocks.zh:
相反,我们对可复制性采用了更“松懈”的假设。
由于承认字节相同的文物不太可能,重新进行计算仍应实质性地重复其相关的实验性索赔,例如,在合理的变异范围内,报告基准的可比较效力。
我们使用“实质性”、“合理性”等模糊的黄鼠狼术语是蓄意的,因为我们需要作出判断,但社区最终将评估我们的说法的真实性。
在此过程中,我们将采用共同接受的标准,例如通过多次试验量化效力差异,并参考文献已记录的现有评价。
归根结底,由于所有文物(拱顶)和密码(断层)的公开提供,第三方可以对我们的索赔进行审计。

blocks.en:
Synthetic data, teacher guidance, and other techniques can significantly increase model effectiveness.
The obvious concern is that they introduce dependencies (both vertices and hyperedges) on proprietary APIs or models, or on models that are themselves not fully open and sovereign.
What do we do?
Here, we attempt to adopt a practical position and exercise judgment on a case-by-case basis—but this is an issue that we frequently grapple with throughout the project.
blocks.zh:
合成数据,教师指导等技术可以大大提高模型效能.
明显的担心是,它们引入了对专有API或模型的依赖性(有顶点和超尖端),或者对本身并不完全开放和主权的模型的依赖.
我们该怎么办?
在这里,我们试图采取一种实际的立场,在个案基础上作出判断,但这是我们在整个项目中经常处理的问题。

blocks.en:
Consider a concrete case: Is the use of synthetic data compatible with our notion of openness and sovereignty?
Let’s assume that the dataset is made publicly available, but was generated by a proprietary model.
Let’s even assume that the associated code was made available (seeds, prompt templates, etc.) but that the data generation process itself requires calling a proprietary API.
Would we consider a model derived from such a dataset fully open and sovereign?
Does the answer to the above question change if the dataset were generated by an open-weight model, in which case it would be possible to recreate the dataset independently?
The same question applies to teacher guidance and other side information, including labels, rankings, scores, and logits.
blocks.zh:
考虑具体案例: 使用合成数据是否符合我们的开放和主权概念?
假设数据集是公开的,
让我们甚至假设相关代码是可用的(种子,即时模板等),但数据生成过程本身需要调用专有API.
我们是否考虑从这种数据集中产生一个完全开放和主权的模型?
如果数据集是由一个开量模型生成,那么对上述问题的答案是否会改变,在这种情况下,可以独立地重制数据集?
同样的问题也适用于教师指导和其他侧面信息,包括标签,排名,分数,和日志.

blocks.en:
In short, we are not committing to a specific conclusion in this report, because the actual answer is likely to be organization- and context-dependent.
Nevertheless, we suspect that an important consideration is whether the use of proprietary or non-open models represents a one-time process (e.g., whose results are captured statically in a dataset) or requires continued access during training (e.g., to determine rewards).
However, our commitment to making vertices and hyperedges publicly available allows others to reach their own conclusions about openness and sovereignty.
Furthermore, the transparency of our approach allows others to examine the impact of proprietary and non-open components via ablation studies.
blocks.zh:
简言之,我们不承诺在本报告中得出具体结论,因为实际答案可能取决于组织和背景。
尽管如此,我们怀疑一个重要的考虑因素是,是否使用专有模式或非开放模式是一次性过程(例如,其结果在数据集中静态地记录),还是需要在培训期间继续获得(例如,确定奖励)。
然而,我们承诺公开提供顶点和顶尖,使其他国家能够就开放和主权问题得出自己的结论。
此外,我们方法的透明度使其他国家能够通过消毒研究审查专利和非开放部件的影响。

blocks.en: 3.4 Why is this important? The Organizational Perspective
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 为什么这很重要? 组织视角

blocks.en:
Sovereign AI encompasses many overlapping and closely related concepts, centered on the idea that organizations—and, by extension, countries—should retain control over their use and governance of AI.
One aspect of sovereignty is the ability to independently build, deploy, and maintain AI infrastructure without requiring the continued cooperation of an external provider.
It is this aspect of sovereignty, focused specifically on models, that we focus on here.
blocks.zh:
主权大赦国际包括许多相互重叠和密切相关的概念,其中心思想是,各组织——以及由此推而广之的国家——应保留对大赦国际的使用和管理的控制。
主权的一个方面是独立建设、部署和维护AI基础设施的能力,而不需要外部提供者的持续合作。
正是主权的这一方面 -- -- 具体侧重于模式 -- -- 我们在此集中关注。

blocks.en:
The ability of organizations to build and deploy their own models enables autonomy and mitigates risks arising from external dependencies.
Reliance on an external model provider exposes an organization to changes in pricing, terms of service, permitted uses, and even continued access.
This is not an abstract concern; recent episodes have raised alarms with many leaders.
On June 12, 2026, Anthropic suspended access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all customers following a US government directive restricting access by foreign nationals, including those within the United States. 12 12 12 https://www.anthropic.com/news/fable-mythos-access Although these export controls were subsequently lifted, 13 13 13 https://www.anthropic.com/news/redeploying-fable-5 the disruption illustrates how organizations can lose access to critical capabilities through decisions outside their control.
blocks.zh:
各组织建立和部署自己的模型的能力,能够实现自主,并减轻外部依赖性引起的风险。
依赖外部模式提供者会使一个组织面临定价、服务条件、允许使用甚至持续使用等方面的变化。
这不是一个抽象的关切;最近的事件已使许多领导人感到震惊。
2026年6月12日,Anthropic在美国政府的一项指令限制外国人,包括美国境内的外国人访问之后,暂停所有客户使用Fable 5和Mythos 5。 虽然这些出口管制随后被解除,但13个网站https://www.harmic.com/news/redeptuling-fable-5 干扰说明各组织如何通过无法控制的决定而失去获得关键能力的机会。

blocks.en:
Geopolitical risks aside, an organization can be at the mercy of an external provider that determines the availability of certain capabilities for particular applications.
Although such dependencies invariably exist with any external service, the increasing importance of AI in all aspects of an organization’s operations increases the risk from not ‘‘owning the means of production’’.
To provide a concrete example: At its launch, Anthropic’s Fable 5 model routed requests flagged by its safeguards---including requests concerning biology and cybersecurity---to a less capable model. 14 14 14 https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5 Regardless of the motivation, such restrictions mean that an organization’s access to certain capabilities may depend on the provider’s policy, over which the organization may have limited control.
blocks.zh:
除地缘政治风险外,一个组织可以听从外部提供者的摆布,由外部提供者决定特定应用的某些能力。
虽然这种依赖性必然存在于任何外部服务中,但大赦国际在组织业务的所有方面日益重要,增加了不拥有生产资料的风险。
举一个具体的例子: 在Anthropic的Fable 5型号申请的启动时,其保障措施标出 -- -- 包括有关生物学和网络安全的请求 -- -- 将其引向能力较差的模型。 无论动机如何,这种限制意味着一个组织获得某些能力可能取决于提供者的政策,而该组织对此的控制可能有限。

blocks.en:
Use of an external model provider also raises questions about control over an organization’s proprietary knowledge in the form of prompts, retrieved documents, and other input that may contain confidential information. Palantir (2026) advises that an organization should insist that model providers operate under a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement, a privacy concept whereby none of an organization’s data in the form of prompts, outputs, and telemetry is retained beyond the ephemeral processing required to fulfill the request.
However, the report goes on to argue that ZDR may not be sufficient as there are other channels for “leakage”, and that ZDR does not guarantee continued access, tying in to the other concerns expressed above.
blocks.zh:
使用一个外部模型提供者也引起了关于以提示、检索文件和其他可能包含机密信息的投入的形式控制一个组织的专有知识的问题。 Palantir(2026年)建议,一个组织应该坚持模型提供者根据零数据保留协议运作,这个隐私概念规定,一个组织以提示、输出和遥测形式提供的数据都不得超出满足请求所需的电平处理。
然而,报告接着指出,ZDR可能不够充分,因为还有其他的“漏水”渠道,ZDR不能保证继续进入,这与上述其他关切有关。

blocks.en:
In this context, our notion of fully open and sovereign models gives an organization greater control over all aspects of a model’s lifecycle, from end to end.
Access to model weights alone (i.e., building on existing open-weight models) may not be sufficient to achieve a desired level of control that an organization would be comfortable with.
Developers of open-weight models make checkpoints available, but they do not necessarily disclose the raw pre-training corpora or other important aspects of the training pipeline, including data processing, alignment, the mid- and post-training phases, etc.
While open-weight models certainly provide useful starting points for deployment, they leave important upstream dependencies unresolved.
blocks.zh:
在这方面,我们关于完全开放和主权模式的概念使一个组织能够从头到尾对一个模式的生命周期的所有方面进行更大的控制。
单靠模型加权(即以现有的开放式加权模型为基础)可能不足以达到一个组织能够接受的预期控制水平。
开放量级模型的开发者提供出站点,但并不一定披露培训管道的原始培训前公司或其他重要方面,包括数据处理,调整,培训中后阶段等.
虽然开放重量模式无疑为部署提供了有益的起点,但它们留下了重要的上游依赖问题未得到解决。

blocks.en: We identify two main challenges with open-weight models:
blocks.zh: 我们用开放式模式确定了两个主要挑战:

blocks.en:
First, incomplete provenance makes it difficult to assess whether the model was trained in a way that satisfies an organization’s requirements in terms of data licensing, data privacy, data quality, etc.
Furthermore, it can be challenging to assess alignment and whether model behavior is consistent with an organization’s values.
For example, it is well known that LLMs can exhibit systematic political and cultural biases associated with their training data and development choices ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Buyl et al., 2024 ) .
For example, a Chinese open-weight model may deny the historic reality of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests and massacre to reflect the position of the Chinese Communist Party.
More insidious are backdoors that can be embedded in LLMs ( Kurita et al., 2020 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Hubinger et al., 2024 ) .
Both of these issues persist even if an organization performs model inference itself in isolation, eliminating the possibility that the model communicates with the original developers.
Although researchers have developed techniques to “re-align” open-weight models ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , successful realignment on evaluated behaviors does not establish that all unwanted behaviors or hidden backdoors have been removed.
The unknown unknowns remain a concern.
blocks.zh:
首先,由于来源不全,难以评估该模式的培训方式是否符合一个组织在数据许可、数据隐私、数据质量等方面的要求。
此外,评估一致性以及示范行为是否符合一个组织的价值观可能具有挑战性。
例如,众所周知,LLMS可能在其培训数据和发展选择方面表现出系统性的政治和文化偏见(Feng等,2023;Buyl等,2024)。
例如,中国的开放重量模式可能会否定1989年天安门广场抗议和屠杀的历史现实,以体现中共的立场.
更阴险的是可嵌入LLMs的后门(Kurita等,2020;徐等,2024;Hubinger等,2024).
即使一个组织单独进行模型推论,这两个问题依然存在,从而消除了模型与原始开发者沟通的可能性.
虽然研究人员开发了“调整”开放量级模型的技术(Chen等,2026年),但成功调整评估的行为并不能确定所有不想要的行为或隐藏的后门已被移除。
不明身份者仍令人关切。

blocks.en:
Second, there is no guarantee that the original developers of an open-weight model will continue to release improved checkpoints under the same license.
Future releases might remain proprietary, adopt more restrictive terms, or prioritize capabilities that do not match an organization’s needs.
An organization can continue to use an existing checkpoint and improve it through further training, but access to weights alone severely restricts the types of experiments and modifications that can be performed.
For example, an organization might wish to rebuild the model using a different data mixture, change the pre-training objective, or investigate a different model architecture.
Such changes require access to upstream artifacts and training recipes that the original developers may not have released.
Thus, an organization whose development strategy relies primarily on continued training or fine-tuning successive third-party checkpoints might find itself in the model equivalent of a “dead end” if those releases cease or become unsuitable.
In this case, further independent progress becomes difficult without substantial effort.
blocks.zh:
其次,无法保证开放量级模型的原始开发者会继续以同样的许可证释放经过改进的检查站.
今后的释放可能仍然是专有的,采用更严格的条款,或确定不符合一个组织需要的能力的优先次序。
一个组织可以继续利用现有的检查站,并通过进一步培训加以改进,但仅获得重量就严重限制了可以进行的实验和改造的类型。
例如,一个组织可能希望使用不同的数据混合物重建模型,改变培训前的目标,或调查不同的模型结构。
这种改变需要获得上游文物和培训秘方,而原始开发者可能还没有发布这些秘方。
因此,一个其发展战略主要依靠继续培训或微调接连不断的第三方检查站的组织可能会发现,如果这些释放停止或变得不合适,其模式相当于“死胡同”。
在这种情况下,如果不作出实质性努力,就很难取得进一步的独立进展。

blocks.en:
As discussed above, the increasingly critical role that models play in an organization requires effective leaders to carefully weigh the benefits and costs of external dependencies, and to prepare risk mitigation strategies in advance.
In summary, fully open and sovereign models alleviate many concerns about open-weight models and allow organizations to retain control “of their own destiny”.
blocks.zh:
如上所述,模型在组织中发挥日益关键的作用,需要有效的领导者认真权衡外部依赖的好处和成本,并事先制定减少风险战略。
总之,完全开放和主权模式减轻了人们对开放性模式的许多关切,使各组织能够保留对“自己命运”的控制。

blocks.en: 3.5 Why is this important? The Academic Perspective
blocks.zh: 3.5 (中文(简体) ). 为什么这很重要? 学术观点

blocks.en:
The previous narrative focuses on openness and sovereignty from the perspective of organizational control.
While the ability to build, deploy, and govern AI without external interference is undoubtedly important, such discussions can seem abstract from the academic perspective. 15 15 15 This is important because, after all, we are an academic institution. Building on previous discussions, we outline two concrete ways in which fully open and sovereign models are important:
blocks.zh:
之前的叙述从组织控制的角度关注开放和主权.
虽然在不受外部干预的情况下建立、部署和管理大赦国际的能力无疑是重要的,但从学术角度看,这种讨论似乎很抽象。 15 15 这一点很重要,因为我们毕竟是一个学术机构。 在以往讨论的基础上,我们概述了两种具体方式,充分开放和主权模式十分重要:

blocks.en: As an academic research group, we are committed to increasing our understanding (of the world, more broadly, and LLMs, more narrowly) in a rigorous manner, and often that cannot be accomplished without transparency into the artifacts that we are studying.
blocks.zh: 作为一个学术研究团体,我们致力于以严格的方式增进我们对(世界范围更广,LLMS范围更窄)的认识,而我们所研究的文物往往没有透明度就无法做到这一点。

blocks.en:
In our recent NanoKnow project ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , we asked a simple question: How do LLMs know what they know?
This question is difficult to answer because pre-training data is either unknown or inaccessible, for both proprietary models and many open-weight models as well.
In a “closed-book” setting, we do not know if an LLM knows a fact because it simply memorized the fact from the pre-training corpus, or perhaps the model made a multi-hop inference based on other memorized facts.
In a RAG setting, where additional context is injected into the model’s prompt, we cannot disentangle the effects of parametric knowledge from the grounding text provided to the model.
Similar questions apply to Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE) ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , a popular technique where an LLM is asked to generate a “fake” hypothetical document that is then used as a pivot for searching “real” documents in an actual collection.
When evaluating models using a benchmark test collection, we don’t know if HyDE is effective because it generalized relevance across different information needs or merely because it had memorized relevant content for the test queries ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
在我们最近的纳诺知识项目(Gu等,2026年)中,我们问了一个简单的问题: LLMS怎么知道他们知道什么?
这个问题难以回答,因为培训前数据要么未知,要么无法获取,无论是专有模型还是许多开量模型。
在“封闭的书”环境中,我们不知道一个LLM是否知道一个事实,因为它只是从培训前的书中记起这个事实,或者也许模型根据其他被记起的事实做了一个多重推断。
在一个RAG的设定中,在模型的提示中注入了额外的上下文时,我们不能将参数化知识的效果从提供给模型的地上文本中分解出来.
类似的问题也适用于假想文件嵌入(HyDE)(Gao等人,2023年),这是一种受欢迎的技术,要求LLM生成一个“假”假设文件,然后用作在实际收藏中搜索“真实”文件的中枢。
在使用基准测试收集来评价模型时,我们不知道HyDE是否有效,因为它在不同的信息需求中具有普遍的相关性,或者仅仅是因为它在测试询问中记住了相关内容(Yoon等,2025年)。

blocks.en:
To summarize, rigorously understanding how models answer questions is often not possible without transparency—in these cases, access to the pre-training corpus.
Transparency provides a starting point to understand the interplay between memorization and generalization in LLMs.
While transparency alone is insufficient, access to the pre-training corpus enables controlled interventions that connect data to observed behavior.
These experiments are not possible with proprietary or even open-weight models.
Unless we are able to train models from scratch, many lines of investigation will remain closed, and along with them, a complete, rigorous understanding of LLM behavior.
blocks.zh:
简言之,严格理解模型如何在没有透明度的情况下回答问题往往是不可能的——在这些情况下,获得培训前的教材。
透明度为了解有限责任公司记忆和概括之间的相互作用提供了一个起点。
虽然单靠透明度是不够的,但利用培训前的手册可以控制干预,将数据与所观察到的行为联系起来。
这些实验用专有或甚至开量模型都是不可能的.
除非我们能够从零开始训练模型,否则许多调查线会一直被关闭,连同它们一起,对LLM行为有一个完整,严格的了解.

blocks.en:
Transparency naturally translates into interventions that address many concerns with proprietary and open-weight LLMs.
Does a portion of the pre-training corpus violate an organization’s requirements in terms of data licensing, privacy, data quality, etc.?
If so, the solution is straightforward: remove the data and retrain a new model.
Does the dataset used for instruction fine-tuning contain instances that are inconsistent with an organization’s values?
If so, the solution is straightforward: remove the offending instances and retrain a new model.
Of course, it is not possible to assure that such ablations maintain model output quality, but these interventions give an organization confidence that specifically identified problems are addressed.
Such options are typically not available for proprietary and open-weight models.
Transparency with fully open and sovereign models allows one to study the impact of interventions in a controlled manner, thereby contributing to a rigorous understanding of model behavior.
blocks.zh:
透明度自然转化为解决专有和开放式有限责任公司所关切的许多问题的干预措施。
培训前文书的一部分是否违反了组织在数据许可、隐私、数据质量等方面的要求?
如果是的话,解决方案是直截了当的:去掉数据并重新训练出一个新的模型.
用于指示微调的数据集是否包含与组织价值不一致的事例?
如果是这样,解决办法是直截了当的:消除违法事例并重新培训新的模式。
当然,不可能确保这种拼接能保持模型产出质量,但这些干预措施使一个组织有信心,能够解决具体查明的问题。
这类选择通常不能用于专有型和开放型。
具有完全开放和主权模式的透明度使人们能够以控制的方式研究干预的影响,从而促进对模式行为的严格理解。

blocks.en:
Another cornerstone of the academic mission is to train the next generation of scholars, scientists, and researchers who will shape the future.
Richard Feynman’s famous quote is apt here: “What I cannot create, I do not understand”.
Our hypergraph organization of LLM training and the view of reproducibility as the traversal of hyperedges provide valuable educational opportunities for students.
There is no substitute for “doing it oneself”, and as previously articulated elsewhere ( Lin, 2022 ) : reproducibility is the starting point for “side quests” that yield greater understanding of the phenomena under examination.
Our hypergraph formulation provides a precise way for students to think through individual steps in a much larger end-to-end training recipe and to explore how local differences may affect overall quality (e.g., in terms of retrieval metrics) via ablations and other contrastive conditions.
blocks.zh:
学术使命的另一个基石是培养下一代将塑造未来的学者,科学家和研究人员.
Richard Feynman著名的引文是: " 我无法创造的,我不明白 " 。
我们的LLM培训的超图组织,以及可复制性作为超尖端的可复制性的观点,为学生提供了宝贵的教育机会。
无法取代“自己这样做”,正如以前在其他地方(Lin, 2022年)所阐明的:可复制性是“侧面追求”的出发点,它使人们对所审查的现象有了更深入的理解。
我们的超平面图配制为学生提供了一个精确的方法,通过单个步骤,在更大的端到端培训配方中思考,并探索局部差异如何会通过活化和其他对比性条件影响整体质量(例如检索度量表).

blocks.en:
Starting from finished checkpoints hides many decisions that are pedagogically important, which we hope that students learn to recognize and question.
How was the pre-training corpus assembled?
How was the final pre-training data mix arrived at?
Where did the training examples come from?
What is the quality of the manually provided judgments?
What is the impact of filtering training examples?
Working through the pipeline and methodically traversing each hyperedge gives students opportunities to question decisions that are captured in existing artifacts and ponder the consequences of alternatives.
A small model trained end to end can provide educational value that is difficult to obtain from fine-tuning a much more capable model whose development is inaccessible.
blocks.zh:
从完成的检查站开始,我们隐藏着许多在教学上很重要的决定,我们希望学生能够学会认识和质疑这些决定。
训练前的训练程序是如何组装的?
最终的培训前数据组合是如何形成的?
培训实例来自何处?
人工提供的判决的质量如何?
过滤培训实例有何影响?
通过管道工作和有条不紊地穿越每个超高地,使学生有机会质疑在现有文物中掌握的决定,并思考替代办法的后果。
训练有素的小型模式结束可以提供教育价值,而通过微调一种能力更强且无法发展的模式很难获得这种价值。

blocks.en:
The educational value also extends beyond successfully executing a recipe.
When a reproduction fails to match the reported result, students must formulate hypotheses, inspect intermediate artifacts, and design experiments that distinguish competing explanations.
They must learn to separate implementation errors from differences in configuration, data, or random variation.
With limited computing resources, they must also decide which experiments are potentially most informative.
These are important research skills, and a transparent training pipeline provides a concrete setting in which to develop them.
blocks.zh:
教育价值也超越了成功执行配方。
当复制不能与报告的结果相匹配时,学生必须提出假设,检查中间的文物,以及区分相竞解释的设计实验.
它们必须学会将执行错误与配置、数据或随机变化的差异区分开来。
利用有限的计算资源,它们还必须决定哪些实验具有最大的潜在信息。
这些都是重要的研究技能,透明的培训管道为开发这些技能提供了具体环境。

blocks.en:
Finally, our hypergraph formulation supports collaboration across students and projects, and even potentially across institutions.
One student might investigate a data-processing step, while another studies a training objective, and a third explores a variant model architecture.
Shared intermediate artifacts allow students to build on each other’s work without independently repeating every computation—yet retaining the ability to examine the impact of one’s decision in an end-to-end task.
This provides a possible answer to the question posed in Section 3.3 : Who traverses the hyperedges?
The answer: individual students, potentially across projects, advisors, and even institutions—in a distributed but coordinated fashion.
The resulting artifacts become both potential research contributions and educational resources for the next group of students.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们的速记设计支持学生和项目之间的协作,甚至可能支持各机构之间的协作。
一名学生可能调查数据处理步骤,而另一名学生研究一个培训目标,而另一名学生则探索一个可变模型结构。
共有的中间工艺品可以让学生在彼此的工作基础上更上一层楼,而不必独立地重复每一次计算 -- -- 还不能保留在最终任务中审查自己决定的影响的能力。
这为第3.3节提出的问题提供了可能的答案: 谁穿越高地?
答案是:个别学生、可能跨项目的学生、顾问、甚至机构——以分布式但协调的方式。
由此产生的文物既成为潜在的研究贡献,也成为下一批学生的教育资源.

blocks.en: 3.6 Openness and Sovereignty
blocks.zh: 3.6 开放性和主权

blocks.en:
Thus far, we have advocated for fully open and sovereign models as a coherent, singular goal.
We conclude this section by distinguishing openness from sovereignty and explaining why Project Greenhouse pursues both.
The two concepts are related, but neither implies the other.
An organization can retain control over its models without making its data, code, or training recipes public.
A frontier lab can be sovereign in this sense by controlling the entire model development process from end to end while keeping its methods proprietary.
Conversely, the public availability of artifacts does not by itself ensure that another organization has the compute, expertise, or other resources needed to independently rebuild and modify a model.
Openness concerns accessibility, whereas sovereignty concerns control.
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,我们一直主张将完全开放和主权模式作为一个连贯而独特的目标。
最后,我们将开放与主权区分开来,并解释 " 温室项目 " 为何两者兼而有之。
这两个概念是相互关联的,但这两个概念都不意味着另一个概念。
一个组织可以保留对其模型的控制,而不公布其数据、代码或培训配方。
从这个意义上说,前沿实验室可以通过控制整个模型开发过程从头到尾,同时保持其方法的专有性而成为主权.
相反地,公开提供文物本身并不能确保另一组织拥有独立重建和修改模型所需的计算、专门知识或其他资源。
开放涉及无障碍,而主权则涉及控制。

blocks.en:
Project Greenhouse is formulated around openness and sovereignty because our goals depend simultaneously on both.
Openness ensures accessibility, which is a prerequisite for the transparency needed to facilitate explorations that lead to rigorous understanding.
As an academic institution, we are committed to sharing findings from our efforts and contributing to publicly accessible knowledge in an open manner.
On the other hand, sovereignty concerns control over dependencies, which affect the bounds of what is knowable for us.
The inability to inspect certain upstream artifacts restricts the types of explorations that we can pursue.
Access to all stages of the model development process enables the rigorous understanding of model behavior that we desire.
blocks.zh:
温室项目是围绕开放和主权制定的,因为我们的目标同时取决于两者。
开放性确保无障碍,这是促进探索所需的透明度的先决条件,可导致严格的理解。
作为一个学术机构,我们致力于分享我们努力的结果并公开促进公众获取知识。
另一方面,主权涉及对附属地的控制,这影响到我们所知的界限。
无法检查某些上游文物限制了我们可以进行的各种勘探。
进入模型开发过程的所有阶段,可以严格理解我们希望的模型行为.

blocks.en:
Together, openness and sovereignty support the rigorous understanding and educational opportunities discussed above.
Our emphasis on modest computational requirements further seeks to make these opportunities feasible for others.
However, we are cognizant of the limitations of our approach: it is unrealistic to imagine competing with an industry lab across a diverse range of capabilities such as general-purpose reasoning, coding, drug discovery, financial analysis, etc.
Instead, we have decided to focus on agentic search, which is broad enough to “matter” but yet narrowly scoped enough that we can make meaningful contributions.
We present one such small, initial contribution.
blocks.zh:
开放和主权共同支持上文讨论的严格的理解和教育机会。
我们强调适度的计算要求,进一步寻求使这些机会对其他人是可行的。
然而,我们认识到我们方法的局限性:设想在诸如通用推理、编码、药物发现、财务分析等各种能力上与工业实验室竞争是不现实的。
相反,我们决定把重点放在代理性搜索上,这种搜索范围很广,足以“有所作为”,但范围很窄,足以作出有意义的贡献。
我们提出一个如此小的初步贡献。

blocks.en: 4 Headline Results
blocks.zh: 4 标题成果

blocks.en:
This report describes how we built Gaggle (base reranker), our pointwise decoder-only reranker, by pre-training a causal language model from scratch on the ClimbMix corpus ( Diao et al., 2025 ) and then fine-tuning the base checkpoint with publicly available query–document relevance annotations curated in RLHN-250K ( Thakur et al., 2025 ) using localized contrastive estimation (LCE) ( Gao et al., 2021 ; Pradeep et al., 2022 ) .
This two-step recipe depends only on commonly available datasets and gives us end-to-end control over model training from initialization through relevance fine-tuning, providing a concrete step toward fully open and sovereign search models.
blocks.zh:
这份报告描述了我们如何通过从头开始对C攀登Mix程序(Diao等,2025年)的因果语言模型进行预训,然后用公开查询对基准检查站进行微调——文件相关说明,在RLHN-250K(Thakur等,2025年)中用局部对比性估计(LCE)(Gao等,2021年;Pradeep等,2022年)。
这种分两步走的食谱仅依赖于常用的数据集,并赋予我们从初始化到相关微调对模型培训的端到端的控制,为完全开放和主权搜索模式提供了具体步骤.

blocks.en:
We were able to accomplish everything described in this report with modest computational resources, using only a handful of GPUs.
All of our supervised fine-tuning experiments can run on a single modern GPU; we typically use one or two GPUs in practice.
For pre-training, the most resource-intensive part of our efforts, we were able to procure limited compute cycles on a single server with 8 × \times H100 GPUs.
blocks.zh:
我们以有限的计算资源完成了本报告所描述的一切,只使用了少数的GPU.
我们所有受监督的微调实验都可以运行在一个单一的现代GPU上;我们通常在实践中使用一到两个GPU.
对于前期训练,我们的努力中资源最密集的部分,我们能够在一个拥有8×\times H100 GPU的单一服务器上采购有限的计算周期.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We implemented a relatively standard multi-stage ranking pipeline ( Nogueira et al., 2019 ) comprised of first-stage (top- k k ) retrieval that returns a ranked list of | k | |k| documents from the corpus of interest.
In our experiments, we used BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) with k = 100 k=100 for first-stage retrieval, as implemented with Lucene in the Pyserini toolkit ( Lin et al., 2021 ) .
Candidate documents from first-stage retrieval are then reranked, as detailed below.
blocks.zh:
我们实施了一个相对标准的多阶段排名管道(Nogueira等,2019年),由第一阶段(top-kk)检索组成,从利益主体中返回一个排名排行榜上的QQQQQKXX文件。
在我们的实验中,我们使用了BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009),其中k = 100 k = 100 用于第一阶段检索,与Lucene一起在Pyserini工具包中实施(Lin等,2021年).
第一阶段检索的候选文件随后重新排序,详情如下。

blocks.en:
For evaluation, we followed standard practice and measured nDCG@10 on test collections from the TREC Deep Learning Tracks 2019–2023 ( Craswell et al., 2019 ; Craswell et al., 2020 ; Craswell et al., 2021 ; Craswell et al., 2022 ; Craswell et al., 2023 ) (DL19–23 for short) and seven BEIR collections ( Thakur et al., 2021 ) : TREC-COVID, TREC-News, Robust04, NFCorpus, SciFact, SCIDOCS, and FiQA.
We evaluated each model once per collection, and for each evaluated model, we computed an unweighted mean of its collection-level scores within each benchmark group (TREC DL and BEIR).
In our experiments, the documents and queries were truncated to 512 and 128 tokens, respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了评价,我们遵循标准做法,在TREC深层学习轨迹2019–2023年的测试采集上测量了nDCG@10(Craswell等,2019年;Craswell等,2020年;Craswell等,2021年;Craswell等,2022年;Craswell等,2023年)(简称为DL19-23)和7个BEIR采集(Thakur等,2021年):TREC-COVID,TREC-News,Robust04,NFCorpus,SciFact,SCIDOCS,和FiQA.
我们每收集一次对每个模型进行评估,对每个评估模型,我们计算出每个基准组(TREC DL和BEIR)内一个未加权的收集级分数平均值。
在我们的实验中,文件和查询分别被缩短到512个和128个信使.

blocks.en:
We fine-tuned our reranker on RLHN-250K ( Thakur et al., 2025 ) , which includes MS MARCO, FiQA, and SCIDOCS-RR among its seven training sources.
Following the original RLHN paper, four out of our seven BEIR evaluation collections—TREC-COVID, TREC-News, Robust04, and NFCorpus—can be considered out of domain with respect to this supervised fine-tuning dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们调整了RLHN-250K(Thakur等人,2025年)的排名,在其7个培训来源中包括MS MARCO、FiQA和SCIDOCS-RR。
在原始RLHN文件之后,我们的七个BEIR评价集——TREC-COVID、TREC-News、Robust04和NFCorpus——中,有四个可以认为与这一有监督的微调数据集无关。

blocks.en: We compared our Gaggle (base reranker) with the following conditions:
blocks.zh: 我们把我们的Gaggle(基地调整器)比作以下条件:

blocks.en:
• BM25: the first-stage retrieval baseline using BM25 scores ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) , implemented with Pyserini ( Lin et al., 2021 ) , evaluated without reranking. • Oracle reranker: we sorted each top-100 BM25 candidate list by decreasing relevance grade from the query relevance judgments (qrels), producing an ordering in perfect agreement with the available relevance judgments.
Unjudged documents received grade zero, and documents with equal grades retained their BM25 order.
This provides the maximum nDCG@10 score achievable by reranking those candidates under the same qrels. • Out-of-the-box listwise rerankers: Gemma-4-26B-A4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) (26B total parameters, 4B active), Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) (27B parameters), and GPT-6.1 Sol were used as listwise rerankers applied to the top-100 BM25 candidates.
For Gemma and Qwen, we used zero-shot, non-thinking generation with windows of 20 candidates, a stride of 10, and a 16,384-token context.
For GPT-6.1 Sol, we used zero-shot generation with minimal reasoning, windows of 20 candidates, and a stride of 10.
Appendix A provides the RankLLM ( Sharifymoghaddam et al., 2025 ) prompt used for these baselines and the Qwen-specific directive omitted for Gemma and Sol. • Jev (shared-rubric scoring): we used the jev-latest model from TypeSafe AI 16 16 16 https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction to score documents using the four-level TREC relevance-grade rubric, supplying the query, documents, and rubric together and sorting by each document’s expected grade.
We supplied all top-100 BM25 candidates in a single request per query.
Jev appears only in the TREC DL comparisons;
Appendix B provides the prompt and scoring rule. • Jina-Reranker-v3: a 0.6B-parameter fine-tuned listwise reranker based on Qwen3 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . 17 17 17 https://huggingface.co/jinaai/jina-reranker-v3 The model jointly encodes the query and candidate documents with causal attention and computes relevance scores using contextual embeddings from each document’s final token.

blocks.en: 4.2 Reranker Effectiveness and Implications
blocks.zh: 4.2 重新排名的效力和影响

blocks.en:
Tables 1 and 2 provide our headline results, showing the effectiveness of our pointwise reranker Gaggle (base reranker) on TREC DL and BEIR in terms of nDCG@10.
Model sizes in billions of parameters are provided as a point of reference.
In the BEIR table, COVID, News, Robust, NFC, and SCID abbreviate TREC-COVID, TREC-News, Robust04, NFCorpus, and SCIDOCS, respectively.
blocks.zh:
表1和表2提供了我们的标题结果,以nDCG@10表示我们在TREC DL和BEIR上的指向调整器Gaggle(基准调整器)的有效性。
提供数十亿参数的模型大小作为参考.
在BEIR表中,COVID,News,Robust,NFC,和SCID分别缩写TREC-COVID,TREC-News,Robust04,NFCorpus,和SCIDOCS.

blocks.en:
The comparisons include BM25, the oracle, out-of-the-box listwise models, and fine-tuned pointwise and listwise rerankers as described above.
Across both benchmark groups (TREC DL and BEIR), Gaggle (base reranker) achieves competitive reranking effectiveness and improves over the BM25 baseline on every collection.
Furthermore, the mean nDCG@10 of Gaggle (base reranker) exceeds those of all fine-tuned pointwise and listwise conditions that we compare against.
On TREC DL, only GPT-6.1 Sol achieves higher effectiveness.
On BEIR, Gaggle (base reranker) achieves effectiveness comparable to Gemma-4, but appears to score lower than Qwen3.8 and GPT-6.1 Sol.
These results place our pointwise reranker, at 3B parameters, favorably among the comparison conditions, including larger models used for out-of-the-box listwise reranking.
It is not a surprise that our model is not as effective as GPT-6.1 Sol, a frontier model.
blocks.zh:
比较包括BM25,甲骨文,外出列表模型,以及如上所描述的精细的指向和列表重排.
在两个基准组(TREC DL和BEIR)中,Gaggle(基准调整器)都实现了竞争性的重新排位有效性,并改进了每集的BM25基线。
此外,Gaggle(基地调整器)的平均值为nDCG@10,超过了我们比较的所有微调点和列表条件。
在TREC DL上,只有GPT-6.1 Sol实现更高的效能.
在BEIR上,Gaggle(Base reranker)实现了与Gemma-4相仿的效能,但似乎得分低于Quen3.8和GPT-6.1 Sol.
这些结果使我们在比较条件中优于3B参数的点位重排,包括用于出列的较大模型重排.
我们的模型不如GPT-6.1 Sol这个前沿模型有效,这并不奇怪。

blocks.en:
The collection-level results reveal variation that is not captured by the benchmark means: Gaggle (base reranker) achieves the highest reported non-oracle nDCG@10 on DL19, even higher than GPT-6.1 Sol.
On BEIR, Gaggle (base reranker) has higher nDCG@10 than GPT-6.1 Sol on TREC-COVID, and comparable effectiveness on SCIDOCS under the noise guideline, while Sol scores higher on the remaining collections.
Our reranker is among the strongest models on TREC-COVID, TREC-News, and SCIDOCS.
blocks.zh:

在BEIR上,Gaggle (base reranker)的nDCG@10比TREC-COVID上的GPT-6.1 Sol更高,在噪声指针下SCIDOCS的可比较效果,而Sol对所余收录的分数更高.
我们的排名是TREC-COVID,TREC-News和SCIDOCS最强的模型之一.

blocks.en:
The score variability study in Section 6.2 finds run-to-run sample standard deviations of approximately 0.001 for benchmark means and 0.003 on average for individual datasets.
Score differences of roughly this magnitude should be treated as experimental noise.
blocks.zh:

大致如此大的分数差异应作为实验噪音处理。

blocks.en:
The oracle upper bound is shown in Row 2 of both result tables, i.e., the maximum possible scores with top-100 BM25 candidate documents.
This gap may reflect scope for reranking improvements as well as noise from incomplete or incorrect relevance judgments.
Further investigation is needed to distinguish these effects.

需要进一步调查,以区分这些影响。

blocks.en:
In support of our central claim in this report—corresponding to the first project milestone of Project Greenhouse—these results show that supervised fine-tuning using a publicly available dataset can produce a competitive reranker from a model checkpoint that we pre-train from scratch, without requiring an intermediate instruction-tuning or alignment stage, mid- or post-training, teacher supervision, synthetic data, or SFT hyperparameter tuning.
Our two-step recipe puts us in control of the entire training process, end to end.
blocks.zh:
为了支持我们在本报告中的核心主张,即 " 温室项目 " 第一个项目里程碑,这些结果表明,利用公开的数据集进行有监督的微调可产生一个我们从头开始训练的示范检查站的竞争性分级器,而不需要中级指示分级或校正阶段、中后培训、教师监督、合成数据或SFT超参数分级分级调用。
我们的两步配方使我们能够控制整个训练过程,结束到结束。

blocks.en:
Most importantly—and contrary to the dominant approach adopted by information retrieval researchers today—we show that it does not appear necessary to start from an existing open-weight model backbone to produce a competitive pointwise reranker.
The comparisons in Tables 1 and 2 assess overall reranking effectiveness across models with different sizes, data mixtures, and training and inference procedures.
Thus, we are not able to isolate any specific factors other than to provide a feasibility demonstration that provides the first step towards validating our broader thesis.
blocks.zh:
最重要的是,而且与信息检索研究者今天采用的主导方法相反,我们表明,似乎没有必要从现有的开放量级模型骨干开始产生一个有竞争力的、有分寸的再排名。
表1和表2的比较评估了不同规模、数据混合物以及培训和推断程序的各种模型的总体重新排序的有效性。
因此,我们无法孤立任何具体因素,只能提供可行性证明,为验证我们更广泛的论文提供第一步。

blocks.en:
Naturally, this headline result raises many interesting questions about the effects of different backbones, different training datasets, and other architectural design choices.
We present contrastive conditions that examine some of these questions in Section 7 , but leave many explorations for future work as we continue to pursue the broader objectives of Project Greenhouse.
blocks.zh:
自然,这一标题结果引起了许多有趣的问题,涉及不同骨干,不同培训数据集以及其他建筑设计选择的效果.
我们提出的对比条件在第7节中审查了其中一些问题,但随着我们继续追求 " 温室项目 " 的更广泛目标,为今后的工作留下了许多探索。

blocks.en: 5 Pre-Training
blocks.zh: 5 预训

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We used nanochat’s depth-34 architecture without modification: a decoder-only transformer with 34 layers, model width 2,176, and 17 attention heads of dimension 128, trained with a 2,048-token context.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了纳米聊天的深度34架构,没有修改:一个只有解码器的变压器,有34层,型号宽度2,176,还有17个尺寸128的注意头,训练有2,048个上下文.

blocks.en:
Our approach combined standard components (rotary position embeddings, QK normalization, parameter-free RMSNorm, a squared-ReLU MLP, untied input and output embeddings, and logit soft-capping) with several lightweight additions from recent speedrun-style designs. 22 22 22 https://github.com/KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt Every other layer has a value embedding, which is a per-token lookup table whose output is mixed into the attention values through a learned gate, adding token-level capacity at almost no compute cost.
Three of every four layers attend within a 512-token sliding window, while the remaining layers attend over the full context.
Learned per-layer scalars rescale the residual stream and mix the input embedding back into every layer.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法将标准组件(旋转位置嵌入、QK常态化、无参数 RMSNorm、平方-RELU MLP、不附带条件的输入和输出嵌入、以及logit软卡)与最近速度跑式设计中的若干轻量级添加部分结合起来。 每个其它的层都有一个数值嵌入,这是一个每层的取景表,其输出通过学习出的一个门被混合到注意值中,以几乎不计算成本的方式增加了信使级容量.
每4个层中有3个在512个托肯滑动窗口内出席,而其余层则在全部上下文中出席.
学习到的每层平面调整了剩余流的分级并混合了嵌入到每层的输入.

blocks.en:
In total, our model backbone has 3.29B parameters: 1.93B in the transformer blocks, 1.21B in the value-embedding tables, and 0.14B in the input and output embeddings.
Because value embeddings are lookups, the total per-token training compute is comparable to that of a dense model with about 2B parameters.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型骨干总有3.29B参数:变压器块有1.93B,价值嵌入表有1.21B,输入和输出嵌入0.14B.
因为价值嵌入是外观,所以总的被接入式训练计算可以和有约2B参数的密集模型相媲美.

blocks.en:
We pre-trained from scratch on the ClimbMix corpus ( Diao et al., 2025 ) , using Karpathy’s document-shuffled release ( karpathy/climbmix-400b-shuffle ).
We held out the last of its 6,543 shards for validation and trained on the rest, packing documents into 2,048-token sequences with nanochat’s BOS-aligned best-fit packing, in which every sequence starts at a document boundary.
Following nanochat’s recipe, we trained a byte-level BPE tokenizer with a vocabulary of 32,768 entries on the first 2B characters of the training split.
blocks.zh:
使用Karopathy的文档-shuffle(Karopathy/climbmix-400b-shuffle),
我们保留了它的6,543个硬盘中的最后一块用于验证,并对其余部分进行了培训,将文件装入2,048个托肯序列,用纳米聊天的BOS相配最合适的包装,每个序列都从文件边界开始。
根据纳米聊天的食谱, 我们训练了一个字节级的 BPE 标语器, 词汇为32,768个条目,

blocks.en:
We kept nanochat’s optimizer and learning-rate schedule unchanged: Muon 23 23 23 https://kellerjordan.github.io/posts/muon/ updates the weight matrices of the transformer blocks and AdamW updates the embeddings and scalar parameters.
Our only modifications were to change the learning rate and the batch size schedule.
blocks.zh:
我们保持纳米聊天的优化和学习率时间表不变:Muon 23 23 https://kellerjordan.github.io/posts/muon/ 更新变压器块的重量矩阵,AdamW更新嵌入和平面参数.
我们唯一的修改是改变学习速度和批量规模时间表。

blocks.en:
Unlike nanochat, which scales its peak learning rates with the square root of the batch size, we kept their peak values unchanged as the batch grows, so each increase cuts the gradient noise much as a learning rate decay would.
Early in pre-training, since the model is not very good, even a small data batch clearly shows the direction of an effective update;
in these situations, a larger batch may provide limited additional benefit per token, while consuming more tokens per step.
Thus, using small data batches at the beginning of pre-training is more data efficient.
blocks.zh:
与用分批量的平方根来测量其峰值学习率的纳米聊天不同,随着分批量的增长,我们保持了它们的峰值不变,因此每次增加都会像学习速率衰减那样减少梯度噪声.
在培训前早期,由于模型不甚好,即使是一小批数据也明确显示有效更新的方向;
在这些情况下,大批量的批次可提供有限的额外利益,同时每步消耗更多的信使。
因此,在预训开始时使用小数据批次,数据效率更高.

blocks.en:
As the loss decreases, however, the signal-to-noise ratio of each batch decreases, so larger batches start to become worthwhile ( McCandlish et al., 2018 ) .
Therefore, we doubled the batch size three times, from 262,144 to 524,288, 1,048,576, and 2,097,152 tokens over the course of training, which also reduced the total number of optimizer steps.
We kept the learning rates fixed throughout the pre-training process, so each increase of the batch size cuts the gradient noise, much as a learning-rate decay would ( Smith et al., 2018 ) .
These batch size increases correspond to the discontinuities in the validation loss plot in Figure 1 .
For example, we see that the validation loss drops suddenly, with a brief spike at the first batch size increase.
blocks.zh:
然而,随着损失的减少,每批次的信号与噪声之比会下降,因此更大规模的批次开始变得值得(McCandlish等,2018年).
因此,我们把批量规模翻了三倍,从262,144个增加到524,288个,1,048,576个;在培训过程中,我们增加了2,097,152个标志,这也减少了优化步骤的总数。
我们在整个培训前过程中都保持了学习率的固定,因此,每批量的提高都会减少梯度噪声,就像学习率的衰减一样(Smith等,2018年)。
这些批量增加与图1中审定损失地块中的不连续情况相对应。
例如,我们看到验证损失会突然下降,在第一批的尺寸增加时会有短暂的激增.

blocks.en:
In total, we pre-trained for exactly one pass over the entire corpus (comprising 287B tokens), on a single server with 8 × \times NVIDIA H100 GPUs with FP8 matrix multiplications.
The entire process consumed roughly 1,600 GPU-hours in this configuration.
blocks.zh:
总而言之,我们预先训练了整整一个通过整个元件(由287B符组成),在一个拥有8×\times NVIDIA H100 GPU并有FP8矩阵乘法的单一服务器上.
整个过程在这个配置中消耗了大约1600个GPU小时.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Validation loss on held-out ClimbMix during pre-training.
blocks.zh: 图1:预训期间被扣留的ClimpMix的验证损失。

blocks.en:
Our GPU budget did not allow for a second pre-training run from scratch, so we adapted the causal model to bidirectional attention following LLM2Vec ( BehnamGhader et al., 2024 ) .
Starting from the causal checkpoint at 245B tokens, we continued pre-training on the remaining 42B tokens with masked next-token prediction (MNTP).
MNTP predicted each masked token from the preceding position while allowing attention to context on both sides.
Each prediction therefore used the same position as in causal next-token training.
Since the checkpoint had no saved optimizer state, we raised the learning rate from zero to 0.26 times the peak over the first 200 steps, where the causal run’s schedule had reached, and then followed that schedule’s linear decay to 0.05 times the peak.
Adaptation used approximately 19,900 steps, a 20% masking rate, and symmetric attention windows.
The adaptation consumed approximately 340 H100-hours.
blocks.zh:
我们的GPU预算不允许从零开始第二次预训,因此我们根据LLM2Vec(BehnamGhader等,2024年)调整了因果模型,使其双向关注.
从245B道具的因果检查点开始,我们继续用口罩下接吻的预测(MNTP)对剩余的42B道具进行预训.
MNTP从上个位置预测出每个被蒙住的标志,同时允许注意双方的背景.
因此,每一种预测都采用了与因果接吻训练相同的立场。
由于检查点没有保存优化状态,因此我们把学习率从零提高到了前200个步骤中峰值的0.26倍,因为因果运行时间已经到来,然后按照该时间线性衰减到峰值的0.05倍。
适应用了大约19,900个步子,20%的遮掩率,以及对称的注意力窗口.
改造耗用约340个H100小时.

blocks.en: 5.2 Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.2 示范评价

blocks.en:
It is, of course, desirable to assess the quality of a pre-trained model intrinsically, without consideration of any specific downstream task.
To evaluate base pre-trained models without post-training, it is necessary to use benchmarks that do not require instruction following:
blocks.zh:
当然,最好在不考虑任何具体下游任务的情况下,从本质上评估预先培训的模式的质量。
为了评价未经培训后就经过培训的基数模型,必须使用不需要下列指导的基准:

blocks.en:
• CORE ( Li et al., 2024 ) : 22 in-context learning tasks from DataComp-LM, covering world knowledge, commonsense reasoning, language understanding, reading comprehension, and symbolic problem solving.
CORE averages accuracy on each task after rescaling the score so that random guessing scores 0 and perfect accuracy scores 1.
We used nanochat’s implementation with up to 500 test questions per task. • MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) : four-option multiple-choice questions on 57 subjects.
We used 5-shot prompts and picked the answer letter (A--D) that the model rates as most likely, using the LM Evaluation Harness. 24 24 24 https://github.com/eleutherai/lm-evaluation-harness • MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) : a harder, ten-option version of MMLU, scored the same way.
We do not use the more common chain-of-thought setting, where the model writes out its reasoning before answering, because its prompts do not fit in our 2,048-token context. Models evaluated locally used the same evaluation code, with each tokenizer’s default special tokens and each model’s own context length.
Our bidirectional variant, which would otherwise see the answer, is scored with the answer tokens masked, as during model pre-training.
In cases where a model developer directly reports the relevant metric, we use the published scores;
otherwise, we performed evaluations ourselves.
blocks.zh:
• CORE(Li等,2024年):来自DataComp-LM的22个内文学习任务,涵盖世界知识、常识推理、语言理解、阅读理解和象征性问题的解决。
CORE在调整分数后平均为每项任务的精度,以便随机猜测分出0分,完美精度分出1分.
我们用纳米聊天的操作,每个任务最多有500个测试问题。 • MMLU(Hendrycks等,2021年):关于57个主题的四可选多选题。
我们使用5发的提示,并选取了最有可能使用LM评价方法的答案(A-D)。 ^ MMLU-Pro (Wang等,2024年):MMLU更难取出十选本,得分相同.
我们不使用更常见的思维链式设定,即模型在回答之前写出其推理,因为它的提示不符合我们2 048个托肯的背景。 当地评价的模型使用相同的评价代码,每个标定器默认的特殊符和每个模型自己的上下文长度.
我们的双向变体,否则会看到答案,就像在模型预训期间一样,被蒙上答案符号的分数.
在模型开发者直接报告相关度量标准的情况下,我们使用公布的分数;
否则,我们自己进行评估。

We do not use the more common chain-of-thought setting, where the model writes out its reasoning before answering, because its prompts do not fit in our 2,048-token context.

blocks.en:
To confirm the correctness of our evaluation code, we validated against published results.
On seven reference models with published CORE scores, our CORE is within 0.011 of published values.
These are: GPT-2 at four sizes ( Radford et al., 2019 ) , OLMo-1B ( Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) , phi-1.5 ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and Qwen2-1.5B ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .
Our MMLU and MMLU-Pro scores are within 0.003 of the stock harness, which in turn reproduces published chain-of-thought MMLU-Pro scores to within 0.02.
CORE fluctuates slightly late in training, so we released the causal checkpoint with the highest CORE (283B tokens) rather than the final model (287B tokens, 0.004 lower).
It is this model checkpoint that we release and evaluate throughout this report.
blocks.zh:
为了确认我们评价守则的正确性,我们对公布的结果进行了验证。
在7个有已公布CORE分数的参考模型上,我们的CORE在已公布值的0.011以内.
它们是:4个尺寸的GPT-2(Radford等,2019年),OLMo-1B(Groeneveld等,2024年),phi-1.5 (Li等, 2023),并出自 Qune2-1.5B (Yang等, 2024.
我们的MMLU和MMLU-Pro的分数在股盘的0.003以内,这反过来又将已公布的思维链MMLU-Pro分数复制到0.02以内.
CORE在训练上稍有后期起伏,因此我们以最高的CORE(283B令牌)而不是最终的型号(287B令牌,更低了0.04)发布了因果检查站.
正是这个示范检查站,我们在本报告全文中予以公布和评估。

blocks.en:
Table 3 compares our models with well-known base models of up to about 7B parameters released in the past year, grouped by whether their pre-training corpus is public.
For reference, the table also includes AI2’s two latest OLMo base models, whose pre-training corpus is publicly available, but which are only available at 7B.
