表3将我们的模型与去年公布的大约7B参数的知名基本模型进行比较,按其培训前教材是否公开分类。
供参考,该表还包含了AI2最新的两种OLMo基模,其预训教材公开提供,但仅以7B提供.

blocks.en:
Based on our evaluation, our causal model scores much higher than nanochat-d34, which was trained with an earlier version of the same codebase on 89B tokens of FineWeb-Edu.
This contrast shows the importance of the pre-training corpus and token budget.
Other interesting observations: Puro 2B achieves a CORE score similar to ours with about five times as many training tokens.
Apart from nanochat-d34, Puro 2B, and OPEN-1B, every model, including all models with undisclosed data, scores higher than ours, but each was trained on 1.7T to 34T tokens or does not report its budget.
The models shown in Table 3 differ in data, architecture, and training recipe, so the comparison places our model among existing checkpoints rather than isolating any single factor.
Our primary goal here is to support the claim that our model checkpoint, pre-trained from scratch ourselves, provides a “reasonable” starting point for subsequent fine-tuning to yield a competitive pointwise reranker.
blocks.zh:
根据我们的评估,我们的因果模型得分远高于纳米聊天-d34,后者在"FineWeb-Edu"的89B令牌上接受了早期版本同名代码库的训练.

其他有趣的观察: Puro 2B以约5倍多的训练符来达到与我们相似的CORE分.
除了纳米聊天-d34,Puro 2B,以及OPEN-1B,每个模型,包括所有未公开的数据的模型,得分都高于我们的,但每个模型都接受了1.7T到34T符号的训练或者不报告预算.
表3中显示的模型在数据、结构和培训方法上各不相同,因此比较将我们的模型放在现有的检查站中,而不是孤立任何单一因素。
我们在这里的首要目标是支持以下说法,即我们自始至终经过培训的示范检查站为随后的微调提供了“合理”的起点,以便产生一个有竞争力的分数调整。

blocks.en: 6 Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 6 监督罚款

blocks.en:
This section details the supervised fine-tuning recipe applied to our pre-trained checkpoint to produce a competitive pointwise reranker.
We provide an exploration of model score variability across four training runs and describe the final model soup Gaggle (base reranker) used for the headline results in Section 4 .
blocks.zh:
本节详述了适用于我们经过预先训练的检查站的有监督的微调配方,以制作一个有竞争力的点分再排名器。
我们探索了四种训练的模型分数变异性,并描述了第4节中用于头条结果的最终模型汤Gaggle(基地再排名).

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
It is well known ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ) that a high-quality pointwise reranker can be fine-tuned from a pre-trained transformer backbone using a collection of query–document relevance pairs.
We adopt this approach, but the biggest variable remains the data recipe: exactly what training data and what data mix.
blocks.zh:
众所周知(Nogueira and Cho, 2019),一个高品质的分点再排行器可以通过一个预先训练的变压器主干线来进行微调,使用收集查询-文档关联对.
我们采取这种方法,但最大的变量仍然是数据配方:确切的说,是哪些培训数据和何种数据组合。

blocks.en:
In this work, we used RLHN-250K, a curated subset of seven retrieval datasets from the BGE training collection ( Thakur et al., 2025 ) .
Its construction uses a small LLM to identify potential false negatives and a stronger LLM to verify them; confirmed false negatives are relabeled as positives, and instances with an excessive number of false negatives are discarded.
The baseline dataset used in training Gaggle (base reranker) therefore already used filtered and relabeled data; further experiments in Section 7.4 examined the effects of additional curation.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们使用了RLHN-250K,这是由BGE培训集(Thakur等人,2025年)的7个检索数据集组成的编译子集。
它的建造使用一个小的LLM来识别潜在的假底片并更强的LLM来验证它们;被确认的假底片被重新贴上正底片的标签,而假底片数量过多的情况被丢弃.
因此,用于培训Gaggle(基地重新排名)的基准数据集已经使用了过滤和重新贴上标签的数据;第7.4节的进一步实验审查了额外校准的影响。

We used localized contrastive estimation (LCE), introduced by Gao et al. (2021) and subsequently studied by Pradeep et al. (2022) .
Both studies found LCE more effective than pointwise cross-entropy (CE), which treats each query–document pair independently.

We fixed the softmax temperature at τ = 1 \tau=1 in all LCE training runs.

We fine-tuned the reranker for one epoch using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with 150 steps of linear warm-up to a peak learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , followed by cosine decay.
We used a common optimization recipe for the contrastive studies, changing the factors specified by each experiment.
We did not perform hyperparameter tuning for the baseline or the contrastive studies in Section 7 , except for the diagnostic comparison of peak learning rates for Gemma and MiniCPM in Section 7.1 .

blocks.en: 6.2 Run-to-Run Variability and Model Averaging
blocks.zh: 6.2 运行到运行的可变性和模式变化

blocks.en:
We performed four baseline supervised fine-tuning runs to characterize run-to-run variation in ranking effectiveness.
Each run started from the same causal pre-trained checkpoint and used the RLHN-250K data, following the same recipe detailed here.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了四次有监督的基线微调,以说明排名效率的从运行到运行的变化。
每跑从同一因果预先训练的检查站开始,使用RLHN-250K数据,沿用了本文所详述的相同食谱.

blocks.en:
To provide more details: runs 1, 3, and 4 used seed 17, while run 2 used seed 18.
Runs 1–3 used two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs; run 4 used two H100 GPUs with gradient caching.
The runs shared the optimization recipe detailed here but differed in execution environment and microbatch configuration, as explained in Appendix C .
Our comparison therefore measures variation across multiple trials that include changes in seed and execution settings.
blocks.zh:
详情如下:跑出1,3和4个已用种子17;跑出2个已用种子18。
跑 1–3使用两个RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU;跑 4使用两个带有梯度缓存的H100 GPU.
如附录C所解释的,这些运行分享了本文详述的优化配方,但在执行环境和微批配置方面却有所不同。
因此,我们的比较衡量了多种试验的不同,包括种子和执行环境的变化。

Finally, we formed a model soup ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ) by averaging all parameters across the final model checkpoints from the four individual runs above, with a weight of 0.25 per checkpoint.
The model soup corresponds to the checkpoint gaggle-reranker-20261005 , which is used to produce our headline result in Section 4 .
blocks.zh:
最后,我们通过平均从四个个人以上运行的最后一个模型检查站的所有参数,形成一个模型汤(Wortsman等,2022年),每个检查站的重量为0.25.
模式汤与检查站的gaggle-reranker-20261005对应,用于制作我们第4节的头条结果.

blocks.en:
Our model soup and individual models are evaluated in exactly the same way with results shown in Table 4 .
To be explicit: the soup scores were obtained from this single averaged model (i.e., this is not so-called results averaging).
The variability of individual runs is summarized in terms of the sample standard deviation across the four individual models.

我们的模型汤和单个模型的评价方式与表4所示结果完全相同。
要明确:汤分数取自于这个单一平均模型(即这不是所谓的平均结果).
单个运行的可变性以四个单个模型的样本标准偏差来概括.

blocks.en:
The four individual runs achieve similar ranking effectiveness:
means of 0.640 ± \pm 0.001 on TREC DL and 0.544 ± \pm 0.001 on BEIR, where ± \pm denotes the sample standard deviation.
We also computed the sample standard deviation separately for each test collection; these values range from 0.001 to 0.004, with an average of 0.003 across the 12 collections.
We use these standard deviation measurements as our guideline for run-to-run noise when interpreting differences in the contrastive studies.
That is, we consider differences that are roughly below this threshold to be experimental noise.
blocks.zh:
这四个个人的排名效果相似:
表示TREC DL上的0.640 ±\pm 0.001和BEIR上的0.544 ±\pm 0.001,其中±\pm表示样本标准差.
我们还为每次测试收集分别计算了样本标准差;这些值从0.001到0.004不等,12个收集的平均值为0.003。
我们在解释对比性研究的不同时,将这些标准偏差测量作为我们从运行到运行噪声的准则.
也就是说,我们认为,大约低于这一阈值的差异是实验性噪音。

blocks.en:
The soup model achieved a mean nDCG@10 of 0.641 on TREC DL and 0.547 on BEIR, exceeding the corresponding averages of the individual runs by 0.001 and 0.003.
Its TREC DL mean matched the strongest individual run, while its BEIR mean exceeded all four individual runs.
Although these gains are close to the observed run-to-run noise scale, the results suggest a potential benefit from parameter averaging, even when all model instances follow the same training recipe.
This appears consistent with previous studies exploring model soups ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
汤模型在TREC DL上实现了0.641和BEIR上达到0.547的平均值nDCG@10,超过了个人运行的相应平均值0.001和0.003.
它的TREC DL表示匹配最强个人跑道,而其BEIR表示超过了所有四个个人跑道.
虽然这些收益接近观测到的从运行到运行的噪音规模,但结果表明,即使所有模型都遵循相同的培训方法,参数平均可能有好处。
这似乎与以前探索模型汤的研究一致(Wortsman等,2022.).

blocks.en: 7 Contrastive Conditions
blocks.zh: 7 对照条件

blocks.en:
In this section, we examine how modeling and training choices affect reranking effectiveness.
Our experiments considered a number of different factors against baseline run 1 of our Gaggle (base reranker), as described in Section 6.2 .
To be clear, we do not compare against the model soup, which would not be methodologically fair.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们审查模式化和培训选择如何影响重新排序的有效性。
正如第6.2节所描述的,我们的实验考虑了与我们的Gaggle基线运行1(基准调整)有关的若干不同因素。
简言之,我们不与模型汤作比较,这在方法上是不公平的。

blocks.en:
We interpret score differences descriptively using the per-trial variability measured in Section 6.2 as a reference.
Specifically, we treat changes on the order of 0.001 in benchmark means or 0.003 on individual collections as experimental noise.
Comparisons use the unrounded evaluation scores.
blocks.zh:
我们以第6.2节中衡量的每审可变性作为参考,对得分差异进行描述性解释。
具体地说,我们把基准值0.001或个别收集值0.003的变动视为实验噪音。
比较使用未四舍五入的评价分数。

blocks.en: 7.1 The Effects of Different Backbones
blocks.zh: 7.1 不同后骨的影响

blocks.en: 7.1.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.1.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Our headline result demonstrates that we are able to fine-tune a pointwise reranker (Section 6 ) from our own pre-trained model checkpoint (Section 5 ).
A natural follow-up question is: What about other model backbones?
How much of our success is attributable to the choice of model backbones?
blocks.zh:
我们的头条结果表明,我们能够从我们自己经过预先训练的示范检查站(第5节)中微调一个有分寸的再排名(第6节)。
一个自然的后续问题就是:其他模型骨干呢?
我们的成功有多少可归因于选择了模型骨干?

blocks.en:
All training runs used causal attention, the standard prompt, the LCE loss function, and the last non-padded token for scoring.
We fine-tuned each model’s text parameters on RLHN-250K, matching the optimization hyperparameters and input-length limits used for our headline results.
blocks.zh:
所有训练都使用因果注意,标准提示,LCE损失函数,以及最后一个非加分符来打分.
我们微调了RLHN-250K上每个模型的文本参数,匹配了用于我们头条结果的优化超参数和输入长度限制。

blocks.en:
Additional details for different backbones: For MiniCPM, we used openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-Base , the model checkpoint with pre-training only, rather than the mid-trained release.
For the multimodal backbones Gemma-4-E2B and Qwen3.5-4B-Base, we discarded the vision encoders and Gemma’s audio encoder, leaving approximately 4.6B and 4.2B trainable parameters, respectively; Gemma’s count includes its per-layer embedding tables.
Reported model parameter sizes in our results table exclude untied output layers, since scoring uses only the two answer-token rows; for example, nanochat-d34 has 2.1B parameters under this convention and 2.2B if we include its output layer.
Each backbone retained its native architecture and tokenizer.
blocks.zh:
不同骨干的其他细节: 对于MiniCPM,我们使用了Openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-Base,模式检查点只进行预训,而不是中训放出.
对于多模式主干线Gemma-4-E2B和Quen3.5-4B-Base,我们放弃了视觉编码器和Gemma的音频编码器,分别留下了大约4.6B和4.2B可列车参数;Gemma的计数包括它的每层嵌入表.
报告的结果表中的模型参数大小排除了不附带条件的输出层,因为评分只使用两个解答键行;例如,纳米聊天-d34在这个常规下有2.1B参数,如果我们包括其输出层则有2.2B.
每个骨干都保留了原生建筑和装饰器.

blocks.en:
We first fine-tuned every backbone with the peak learning rate used in our headline results, which is 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} .
Additional analyses showed that this peak was too high for Gemma-4-E2B and MiniCPM, so we reran both with a peak learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1{\times}10^{-5} , keeping the warm-up and decay schedule unchanged (details below).
blocks.zh:
我们首先用头条成绩中使用的峰值学习率来微调每一个骨干,
更多的分析表明,这个峰值对于Gemma-4-E2B和MiniCPM来说太高了,因此我们重新提出两个峰值学习率分别为1×10−5 1 ×times}10×5 },使暖和衰变时间表保持不变(详情如下).

Experimental results of reranker effectiveness with different backbones are shown in Table 5 .
Using the shared supervised fine-tuning recipe, baseline run 1 of Gaggle (base reranker) achieves a higher mean nDCG@10 than the other backbones on both TREC DL and BEIR, with differences exceeding the run-to-run noise guideline.
Outperforming nanochat-d34 did not come as a surprise, since our backbone was pre-trained from a better data mix, but results for the other backbones were surprising.
In particular, given that Gemma and MiniCPM achieve higher CORE, MMLU, and MMLU-Pro scores (see Table 3 ), we found it perplexing that using these backbones as a starting point for supervised fine-tuning resulted in a less effective reranker.
blocks.zh:
不同骨干重排效果的实验结果见表5。
使用共享的受监督的微调配方,Gaggle (base reranker) 第1个基线运行在TREC DL和BEIR上实现了比其他主干线更高的平均nDCG@10,差异超过跑到跑的噪声准则.
表现不佳的纳米聊天-d34并不令人惊讶,因为我们的骨干从更好的数据组合中预先训练出来,但其他骨干的结果却令人惊讶.
特别是,鉴于Gemma和MiniCPM的CORE、MMLU和MMLU-Pro的分数较高(见表3),我们感到困惑的是,使用这些骨干作为监督微调的起点导致调整效率较低。

blocks.en:
We followed up and examined the training dynamics of Gemma and MiniCPM to better understand their lower reranking effectiveness with the shared recipe.
All backbones initially used the same peak learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , which we had used for our headline results without hyperparameter tuning.
On identical batches, training losses for Gemma and MiniCPM increased as the learning rate reached its peak, while losses from our model continued to decrease, as shown in Figure 3(a) .
blocks.zh:
我们跟踪和研究了Gemma和MiniCPM的培训动态,以更好地了解它们用共同的食谱重新排序的较低效力。
所有骨干最初使用相同的峰值学习率为5×10−5相5相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
在相同的批次中,Gemma和MiniCPM的培训损失随着学习率达到高峰而增加,而我们的模型造成的损失继续减少,如图3(a)所示。

blocks.en:
We considered differences in weight scale as a possible explanation.
Our backbone was pre-trained with Muon and had weight matrices approximately five times larger in scale than those of Gemma and MiniCPM, which were pre-trained with AdamW.
We hypothesized that the shared learning rate produced larger updates relative to the smaller weights in Gemma and MiniCPM, contributing to their increases in training loss.
In other words, the learning rate appeared to be too large.
blocks.zh:
我们认为,重量尺度的差异是一个可能的解释。
我们的骨干与穆恩一起接受过预先训练,其重量矩阵的规模大约是Gemma和MiniCPM的五倍,后者与AdamW一起接受过预先训练。
我们假设,与Gemma和MiniCPM的重量较小相比,共享学习率产生更大的更新,导致培训损失增加。
换言之,学习率似乎过高。

blocks.en:
To test this explanation, we repeated supervised fine-tuning for Gemma and MiniCPM, but with a smaller peak learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , keeping the other training settings unchanged.
The lower rate eliminated the increase in training loss, seen in Figure 3(b) .
Both backbones reached TREC DL effectiveness comparable to baseline run 1, while MiniCPM achieves a higher BEIR mean beyond the noise guideline.
These results are consistent with the proposed weight-scale explanation and suggest that learning-rate sensitivity should be considered when comparing backbones under a shared training recipe.
blocks.zh:
为了测试这个解释,我们重复了对Gemma和MiniCPM的监督微调,但峰值学习率小于1×10−5 1\times 10×5},其他训练设置保持不变.
较低的比率消除了培训损失的增加,见图3(b)。
这两个主干线都达到了TREC DL效能可与基线运行1相媲美,而MiniCPM则实现了比噪声准则更高的BEIR平均值.
这些结果与拟议的权重尺度解释一致,并建议在根据共同培训方法比较主干时应考虑学习率敏感性。

blocks.en:
We find that, starting from MiniCPM, it is possible to train a pointwise reranker that is more effective than our Gaggle (base reranker).
However, the fact that there are ‘‘better’’ pre-trained checkpoints available to fine-tune does not detract from our core thesis. 29 29 29 In fact, it would be suspicious otherwise, that somehow we had stumbled onto the best pre-trained model for our task with minimal exploration of the design space. Our claims focus on sufficiency, that our own model checkpoint pre-trained from scratch can produce a competitive reranker, which remains true.
In other words, at least for the task of pointwise reranking, it appears that our pre-training recipe is “good enough”.
This allows us to retain full end to end control of the training pipeline.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,从MiniCPM开始,可以训练出一个比我们的"Gaggle"(基地再排名)更加有效的有分寸的再排名器.
然而,有经过预先训练的检查站可以进行微调,这一事实并不减损我们的核心理论。 29 29 事实上,如果不然,令人怀疑的是,我们以很少探索设计空间的方式偶然发现了我们任务中经过预先训练的最佳模式。 我们的主张侧重于充足性,即我们自己的模式检查站从头到尾经过预先训练,可以产生一个竞争性的重新排名,这仍然是事实。
换句话说,至少对于明智地重新排序的任务来说,我们的培训前方法似乎“足够好”。
这使得我们得以继续完全结束对训练管道的控制。

blocks.en: 7.2 The Effects of Training Data
blocks.zh: 7.2 培训数据的影响

blocks.en: 7.2.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.2.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
It is well known, across diverse machine-learning applications, that model effectiveness depends on the size of the training dataset and the composition of the training instances.
In our next series of experiments, we attempted to isolate the effects of the data recipe.
blocks.zh:
众所周知,在各种机器学习应用程序中,模型的有效性取决于培训数据集的规模和培训实例的构成。
在我们接下来的一系列实验中,我们试图隔离数据配方的效果.

blocks.en:
One obvious starting point is to examine the variant datasets prepared by Thakur et al. (2025) using the same initialization and training recipe: RLHN-250K (247,534 instances) versus RLHN-680K (648,762 instances).
Since we applied exactly the same training recipe, training models under both data conditions for one epoch, the larger dataset increases the number of instances by a factor of 2.62 and the number of optimization steps from 1,931 to 5,060.
blocks.zh:
一个明显的起点是审查由Thakur等人(2025年)利用相同的初始化和培训方法编制的变相数据集:RLHN-250K(247,534例)与RLHN-680K(648,762例).
由于我们在一个时代的两种数据条件下都采用了完全相同的培训方法,因此较大的数据集使实例数量增加了2.62倍,优化步骤从1 931个增加到5 060个。

blocks.en:
Note that the number of training instances is not the only difference between these variants; the source distribution also changes.
In moving from RLHN-250K to RLHN-680K, MS MARCO increases from 55.2% to 70.2% of the data and HotpotQA from 12.1% to 13.0%.
The share of Natural Questions decreases from 12.0% to 8.9%, although RLHN-680K contains more Natural Questions training instances than RLHN-250K.
FEVER, SCIDOCS-RR, FiQA, and ArguAna retain approximately the same instance counts and consequently account for smaller fractions of the total dataset size.
blocks.zh:
请注意,培训实例的数目不是这些变体之间的唯一差别;源的分布也发生变化。
在从RLHN-250K向RLHN-680K移动的过程中,MS MARCO从55.2%增加到70.2%的数据和热点QA从12.1%增加到13.0%.
自然问题的比例从12.0%下降到了8.9%,尽管RLHN-680K包含的自然问题培训实例比RLHN-250K更多.
FEVER、SCIDOCS-RR、FiQA和ArguAna保留了大约相同的例数,因此占数据集总尺寸的一小部分。

blocks.en:
To provide a point of contrast on data composition, we also trained on 399,600 prepared instances from the Tevatron MS MARCO dataset, 30 30 30 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tevatron/msmarco-passage using the same causal backbone, LCE objective, and one-epoch training recipe.
Note that Tevatron contains only MS MARCO data, whereas RLHN-250K combines seven collections and includes LLM-assisted relabeling of false negatives ( Thakur et al., 2025 ) , so the datasets differ in terms of size, composition, and preparation.
The Tevatron and RLHN-250K datasets each provide approximately 30 negative passages per query on average.
The larger Tevatron dataset required 3,112 optimizer updates, compared with 1,931 for RLHN-250K.
blocks.zh:
为了提供数据构成的对比点,我们还从Tevatron MS MARCO数据集、30 30 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tevatron/msmarco-passage中,利用同样的因果主干、LCE目标以及一次性培训配方,培训了399 600例。
注意Tevatron只包含MS MARCO数据,而RLHN-250K结合了7个集合,并包括了LLM辅助的假阴性再贴标签(Thakur等,2025年),因此数据集在大小,组成和制备方面有所不同.
Tevatron和RLHN-250K数据集平均每个查询提供约30个负面段落.
较大的Tevatron数据集需要3,112个优化器更新,而RLHN-250K的更新为1,931个.

blocks.en:
Effectiveness results are shown in Table 6 .
Training on the larger RLHN dataset increases mean nDCG@10 on TREC DL from 0.641 to 0.646, an improvement larger than the benchmark-level noise guideline.
Gains on four of the five TREC DL collections exceed the typical collection-level noise scale, while the DL21 difference falls below the threshold.
The BEIR mean changes from 0.544 to 0.545, which we treat as experimental noise.
This average hides larger collection-specific changes, including an increase of 0.017 on TREC-News and a decrease of 0.015 on TREC-COVID.
The TREC DL gains are consistent with the increased emphasis on MS MARCO in the larger dataset, but this comparison does not isolate the effects of dataset size, source distribution, and additional optimization steps.
blocks.zh:
成效结果见表6。
关于大型RLHN数据集的培训意味着TREC DL的nDCG@10从0.641增加到了0.646,这一改进大于基准级噪声指导.
5个TREC DL集中4个集的增益超过了典型的收集级噪声尺度,而DL21相差则低于阈值.
BEIR是指从0.544到0.545的改变,我们把它视为实验噪声.
这一平均数掩盖了针对收集的较大变化,包括TREC-News增加0.017和TREC-COVID减少0.015.
TREC DL增益与更大的数据集对MS MARCO的更多强调是一致的,但这种比较并不孤立数据集大小,源位分布,以及额外优化步骤等的影响.

blocks.en:
On TREC DL, training on RLHN-250K yields higher reranking effectiveness than training on Tevatron MS MARCO, with a difference of 0.023 in mean nDCG@10.
Both datasets included MS MARCO, but Tevatron provides more training instances and optimizer updates.
The hard-negative mining and LLM-assisted relabeling in RLHN-250K may provide higher-quality negatives with fewer false-negative labels, contributing to this difference.
The effectiveness gap is larger on BEIR, at 0.074 mean nDCG@10, consistent with the expected benefit of broader training-domain coverage.
Tevatron contains no BEIR training collections, whereas RLHN-250K includes FiQA and SCIDOCS-RR, covering two of the seven BEIR evaluation domains.
blocks.zh:
关于TREC DL,关于RLHN-250K的培训比关于Tevatron MS MARCO的培训产生更高的再级别效力,平均nDCG@10的差为0.023.
两个数据集都包括了MS MARCO,但Tevatron提供了更多的培训实例并优化了更新.
RLHN-250K的硬阴性开采和LLM辅助再贴标签可能会提供质量更高的底片并减少假阴性标签,导致这种差异.
在BEIR中,效力差距较大,为0.074平均值nDCG@10,这符合更广泛的培训领域覆盖的预期好处。
Tevatron没有BEIR训练集,而RLHN-250K则包括FiQA和SCIDOCS-RR,涵盖七个BEIR评价领域的两个.

blocks.en:
Table 7 tracks effectiveness over the course of RLHN-250K training, using the same top-100 BM25 reranking protocol as our headline results.
We see that most of the improvements in effectiveness arrive early.
By roughly 150K queries, results on both benchmarks are close to their final scores, and the remaining instances contribute only small gains.
However, the two benchmarks appear to behave differently along the way.
Effectiveness on BEIR improved steadily throughout, but effectiveness on the TREC DL collections declined mid-training while the learning rate remained high but scores recovered as the learning rate decayed.
This pattern suggests sensitivity to the learning-rate schedule, consistent with the observations in Section 7.1 .
blocks.zh:
表7在RLHN-250K训练过程中跟踪效果,使用与我们头条结果相同的上-100 BM25重排协议.
我们看到,在效力方面的大多数改进都提前到来。
通过大约150K次查询,两个基准的结果接近其最终得分,其余例子只带来小收益。
然而,这两项基准在发展过程中的表现似乎有所不同。
在整个过程中,贝鲁特IR的效益稳步提高,但TREC DL的收录效果下降,而学习率仍然很高,但随着学习率的衰败,分数恢复了。
这种模式表明,与第7.1节中的意见一致,对学习率表很敏感。

blocks.en: 7.3 The Effects of Causal versus Bidirectional Modeling
blocks.zh: 7.3 因果关系与双向建模的影响

blocks.en: 7.3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.3.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
In these experiments, we compared causal and bidirectional attention, prompt changes, and mean pooling.
All variants followed the basic experimental setup described in Section 6.1 , but with changes to the starting checkpoint, attention pattern, prompt, and readout, specified below.
blocks.zh:
在这些实验中,我们比较了因果和双向的注意, 即时变化, 也就是集合。
所有变体都遵循了第6.1节所描述的基本实验设置,但随着起始检查站的改变,注意模式,即时,并读出,具体如下.

blocks.en: The two starting checkpoints were:

blocks.en: • gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-climbmix-20260924 (the causal variant), and • gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-climbmix-bidirectional-20260929 (the bidirectional variant).
blocks.zh: • Gaggle-nanochat-pressed-climbmix--20260924 (因果变体),和 • gaggle-nanochat- pretrained-climbmix-bidified-20260929 (双向变体).

blocks.en: gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-climbmix-20260924 (the causal variant), and
blocks.zh: gaggle-nanochat- 预训- climbmix-20260924 (因果变体),以及

blocks.en: gaggle-nanochat-pretrained-climbmix-bidirectional-20260929 (the bidirectional variant).
blocks.zh: gaggle-nanochat- 预训- climbmix- 双向-20260929 (双向变体).

blocks.en:
The bidirectional variant was adapted from an earlier causal checkpoint using MNTP, as described in Section 5.1 .
The two backbones differed in their final pre-training but were trained on roughly the same number of tokens.
blocks.zh:
如第5.1节所描述的,双向变体是从早先使用MNTP的因果检查站改编而来。
这两所骨干在最后的预训中有所不同,但培训对象大致相同。

blocks.en:
We also tested a query–passage–query (QPQ) prompt under causal attention.
The first query conditions passage representations, while the repeated query enables the model to attend to the passage before scoring.
This placement is motivated by Jina-Reranker-v3, which places a query before and after the candidate documents ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
This prompt design is also related to echo embeddings, in which the prompt repeats an input and extracts embeddings from the second occurrence, whose tokens can attend to the complete first occurrence under causal attention ( Springer et al., 2025 ) .
In our reranker, we repeat only the same truncated query around a single passage and retain the baseline scoring function.
The short context window of our pre-trained checkpoint prohibits direct adoption of Jina’s multi-document recipe, although repeating the query is feasible for our model.
blocks.zh:
我们还在因果关注下测试了一个查询-通过-query(QPQ)提示。
第一个查询条件通过表示,而重复查询则使模型能够在打分前处理通过.
这种安置的动机是Jina-Rranker-v3,它会在候选人文件(Wang et al.,2025.)前后进行查询。
这种即时设计也与回声嵌入有关,其中即时重复输入并取出从第二次发生时的嵌入,而第二次发生时的活字能以因果注意的方式处理完整的第一次发生(Springer等,2025年).
在我们的重新排名中,我们只重复同一个短短的查询 围绕一个段落,并保留基线分数函数。
我们经过预先训练的检查站的短上下文窗口禁止直接采用Jina的多文件配方,尽管对我们的模式来说重复查询是可行的。

Repetition may help by giving the model query representations that have been conditioned by the candidate document before the final scoring position, without requiring any changes to its pre-trained causal attention pattern.
This is a possible explanation for the observed effectiveness improvement.

blocks.en:
To understand why bidirectional adaptation yields ranking effectiveness comparable to the causal baseline, we tested whether the adapted rerankers attended to later tokens.
We selected DL19, DL20, and SciFact to cover both TREC DL and BEIR under the in-domain classification used in Section 4.1 .
Their small query sets (43, 54, and 300 queries, respectively) kept the diagnostic evaluation inexpensive.
With model weights fixed, blocking attention to later tokens reduced mean nDCG@10 across these three collections from 0.753 to 0.700 for the standard prompt and from 0.750 to 0.688 for the mask-appended prompt.

我们选择了DL19、DL20和SciFact,在第4.1节中使用的域内分类法下涵盖TREC DL和BEIR。
它们的小型查询组(分别为43个、54个和300个查询)使诊断评价费用低廉。

These decreases show that the adapted models rely on bidirectional attention.

blocks.en:

Together, these results show that the adapted models do make use of bidirectional attention, but without a clear reranking advantage over the causal baseline.

blocks.en: 7.4 The Effects of Self-Filtering and Self-Distillation
blocks.zh: 7.4 自失能和自失能的影响

blocks.en: 7.4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
In these experiments, we compared the baseline trained on RLHN-250K with two variants: additional self-filtering of the training data and self-distillation on the self-filtered data.
The first comparison examined the effect of filtering; the second examined the added value of score supervision from the trained baseline checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
在这些实验中,我们比较了在RLHN-250K上训练的基线与两个变体:额外的自过滤训练数据以及自过滤数据上的自蒸.
第一次比较审查了过滤的效果;第二次比较审查了训练有素的基线检查站分数监督的附加价值。

blocks.en:
We used the model checkpoint from baseline run 1 to identify potentially noisy positives in RLHN-250K.
For each training query, we scored all positive and negative passages and removed a positive if more than max ⁡ ( 9 , 0.375 ​ N ) \max(9,0.375N) negatives received a higher score, where N N is the total number of negatives available for that instance before sampling.
Queries with no remaining positive relevance judgments were then discarded.
We did not apply this procedure to ArguAna, which was one of the seven training sources in RLHN-250K ( Thakur et al., 2025 ) , because its task requires retrieving counterarguments, which may not align with the model’s general relevance judgments.

我们用1号基线的检查点模型 来识别RLHN -250K中 可能很吵的阳性
对于每个训练查询,我们都会打出所有正负的分数,并去除一个大于最大分数的正负分(9分,0.375分)\max(9分,0.375分)得到更高的分数,其中NN是采样前这个例子可用的负分总数.
随后,没有剩余积极相关判决的查询被放弃。
我们没有将这一程序适用于ArguAna,而ArguAna是RLHN-250K(Thakur等人,2025年)的七个培训来源之一,因为它的任务需要检索反证,可能与模型的一般相关判断不一致。

blocks.en:
This filtering procedure removed 14,887 positive passages (2.6%) and 1,484 queries (0.6%), leaving 246,050 queries in the dataset.
We then trained a new reranker on the retained data using the same LCE objective and training recipe as our baseline run 1.
The checkpoint from baseline run 1 supplied the filtering decisions, while the new reranker was initialized from the original pre-trained checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
这一过滤程序移除了14,887个正通道(2.6%)和1,484个查询(0.6%),在数据集中留下了246,050个查询.
然后,我们用与基线运行1相同的LCE目标和培训配方对保留数据进行了新的重新排名。
从基线跑道1开始的检查站提供了过滤决定,而新的重新排名则从原先经过预先训练的检查站起步。

blocks.en:
We also explored whether the baseline checkpoint can provide useful supervision beyond data filtering.
One common ranking-distillation objective is Margin-MSE ( Hofstätter et al., 2020 ) , which minimizes the squared difference between teacher and student score margins for pairs of passages.
We did not select this objective, but instead used Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence to match LCE’s groupwise softmax formulation: LCE supervises the documents with positive labels, while KL divergence transfers the teacher’s relative preferences over the sampled negatives to the student.
For a fixed teacher, minimizing KL divergence is equivalent to minimizing cross-entropy with soft targets.
This motivates our objective formulation here, without making any empirical claims about effectiveness compared to Margin-MSE.
blocks.zh:
我们还探讨了基线检查站能否提供除数据过滤之外的有益监督。
一个常见的排位-分级目标就是Margin-MSE(Hofstätter等,2020年),它最大限度地缩小了师生对双行道的平分差.
我们没有选择这个目标,而是使用 Kullback - Leibler (KL) 的分数来匹配 LCE 的分组软马克斯配方 : LCE 监督带有正标签的文档,而 KL 差异将老师相对于被抽样的负数的相对偏好转移给学生.
对于固定的老师来说,将KL相差最小化相当于将有柔性目标的交叉通向最小化.
这激励了我们在这里的客观表述,没有提出与Margin-MSE相比任何关于有效性的经验性主张.

Experimental results are shown in Table 9 .
We see that self-filtering improves mean BEIR nDCG@10 from 0.544 to 0.548, beyond the benchmark-level noise guideline, while TREC DL effectiveness remains within run-to-run noise.
The largest observed gain was on TREC-News, increasing from 0.510 to 0.529 and exceeding the typical collection-level noise threshold.

blocks.en:
A common alternative, naturally, is to distill supervision from a stronger teacher.
In line with our focus on sovereign AI, we opted for self-filtering and self-distillation using variants of our own models to avoid an additional external teacher over which we may not have control.
We leave alternative formulations of distillation for future work.

一个常见的替代方法,自然是从更强的老师那里提炼出监督.
根据我们对主权AI的关注,我们选择了自我过滤和自我消化,使用我们自己的模型的变体来避免增加我们可能无法控制的外部教师。
我们为今后的工作留下了替代的蒸馏配方。

blocks.en: 7.5 The Effects of Different Loss Functions
blocks.zh: 7.5 不同损失函数的影响

blocks.en: 7.5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
In these final experiments, we compared LCE with pointwise cross-entropy (CE), implemented as answer-token prediction.
The CE experiment used the same sampled positive and negative query–document pairs and the same optimizer-step plan as LCE.
This setting also matched the pre-trained initialization, standard prompt, optimization settings, random seed, training precision, and input-length limits.
blocks.zh:
在这些最后的实验中,我们比较了LCE与指针交叉的(CE),作为解答键的预测执行.
CE实验使用了与LCE相同的被抽样正负查询-文件对和相同的优化器步骤计划.
此设定还符合预训初始化,标准即时,优化设置,随机种子,训练精度,和输入长度限制.

blocks.en:
With the CE loss function, we trained the model to take each pair as input to predict a single ␣true or ␣false answer token.
This approach retains the full pre-trained language-model output layer and averages answer-token cross-entropy over the pairs, with normalization over the entire vocabulary.
With LCE, the model instead retains only the two scoring rows and averages contrastive losses over query groups.
This comparison therefore evaluates standard supervised fine-tuning against our LCE recipe under matched training exposure.
blocks.zh:
使用 CE 丢失功能,我们训练模型将每对都作为输入来预测一个"真"或"假"的回答符号.
这种方法保留了全部预训语言-模型输出层和对子上方的平均回音-token相交,整个词汇的规范化.
与LCE相比,模型只保留了两个分数行和平均比对查询组的损失.
因此,这一比较评估了在相应培训下对照我们的LCE配方进行的标准监督微调。

blocks.en: 8 Related Work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en: 8.1 AI Sovereignty
blocks.zh: 8.1 大赦国际主权

blocks.en:
The idea of AI sovereignty is not new.
Canada’s national AI strategy from 2017 already emphasized retaining domestic talent and economic benefits from AI. 31 31 31 Canada’s Budget 2017: Skills, Innovation and Middle Class Jobs. In a speech dating to March 2018, French President Emmanuel Macron linked AI infrastructure and development to French sovereignty and retaining economic value in France and Europe. 32 32 32 Emmanuel Macron’s speech on AI, March 29, 2018. The concept has been steadily gaining prominence: In February 2024, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang asserted at the World Governments Summit in Dubai that every country needs to own the production of their own intelligence. 33 33 33 Jensen Huang on sovereign AI at the World Governments Summit, February 12, 2024. Sovereign AI has also attracted substantial attention from major consulting firms such as Deloitte, McKinsey, Accenture, and BCG, all of which have opined on various aspects of this complex topic.
The Linux Foundation ( Gerosa et al., 2025 ) identified open source as a foundation for sovereignty through transparency, adaptability, and reducing dependence on individual vendors.
Although initially articulated through the lens of national concerns, sovereignty has increasingly been discussed at the level of individual organizations.
Recent episodes concerning access to frontier models from Anthropic (discussed in Section 3.4 ) have thrust questions about AI sovereignty into the spotlight.
blocks.zh:
AI主权的理念并非新意.
加拿大2017年的国家AI战略已经强调保留国内人才和来自AI的经济利益. 31 31 加拿大2017年预算:技能,创新和中产阶级工作. 在2018年3月的一次演讲中,法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙将AI的基础设施与发展与法国主权联系起来并保留了法国和欧洲的经济价值. 32,32 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在AI上的讲话,2018年3月29日. 这一概念越来越突出: 2024年2月,NVIDIA创始人兼CEOJensen Huang在迪拜举行的世界政府峰会上断言,每个国家都需要拥有自己制作的情报。 (原始内容存档于2024年2月12日) (中文(中国大陆) ). 黄在2024年2月12日"关于主权AI"的世界政府峰会. 主权AI也吸引了德勤、麦肯锡、Accenture和卡介苗等主要咨询公司的大量关注,所有这些公司都对这一复杂专题的各个方面发表了看法。
Linux基金会 (Gerosa等,2025年)通过透明度、适应性和减少对个别供应商的依赖,将开放源码确定为主权的基础。
虽然主权问题最初是通过国家关注的视角来阐述的,但主权问题越来越多地在个别组织一级得到讨论。
最近关于从Anthropic进入边境模式的事件(第3.4节讨论)使有关大赦国际主权的问题成为焦点。

blocks.en:
Alex Karp, the CEO of Palantir, has prominently advocated for AI sovereignty in recent months, emphasizing the importance of organizations retaining control over their institutional knowledge and their ‘‘means of production’’.
These arguments were more precisely laid out in August 2026, 34 34 34 Alex Karp’s Q2 2026 letter to shareholders, August 3, 2026. but they can be traced back to public interviews in July.
He warns of model providers misappropriating customers’ business data and capturing their “alpha” (an organization’s distinctive knowledge and capabilities that give it a competitive advantage).
Another concern he raised is the cost associated with LLMs and organizations not necessarily deriving value from token spend.
LLM inference costs provide another rationale for the pursuit of sovereign AI: any organization dependent on external model providers will have limited control over pricing charged by third parties.
Thus, as part of sovereignty efforts, many organizations are exploring whether smaller, and therefore cheaper, task-specific models might be just as effective as frontier models (more discussion below).
blocks.zh:
最近几个月,帕兰蒂尔的首席执行官亚历克·卡普(Alex Karp)大力主张大赦国际的主权,强调各组织必须保持对其机构知识和生产手段的控制。
这些论点在2026年8月34日,34日,34日,亚历克思·卡普的Q2 2026给股东的信"2026年8月3日"中得到了更准确的阐述. 但可以追溯到7月的公开采访.
他警告说,模型提供者挪用客户的商业数据并获取他们的 " alpha " (一个给予其竞争优势的组织的独特知识和能力)。
他提出的另一个关切是与有限责任方案和组织有关的费用不一定从象征性开支中产生价值。
LLM推论成本为追求主权AI提供了另一个理由:任何依赖于外部模型提供者的组织将对第三方收取的定价拥有有限的控制.
因此,作为主权努力的一部分,许多组织正在探讨较小的、因而更便宜的具体任务模式是否与前沿模式一样有效(下文将作进一步讨论)。

blocks.en:
In a white paper from July 2026 to complement many of Karp’s arguments, Palantir (2026) argues for sovereignty from the perspective of an organization owning the value created through AI and the freedom to pursue new opportunities.
The choices that an organization makes with respect to AI model usage can narrow or broaden these economic rights.
The report laid out recommendations spanning models, compute, and operational control.
It argues that zero data retention alone is insufficient: organizations must also preserve the ability to switch providers and retain the knowledge and improvements generated through their use of AI.
blocks.zh:
Palantir(2026年)在2026年7月的一份白皮书中,
一个组织在AI模式使用方面的选择可以缩小或扩大这些经济权利。
该报告提出了涉及模型、计算和业务控制的建议。
它争辩说,仅保留零数据是不够的:各组织还必须保持转换提供者的能力,并保留通过使用AI所产生的知识和改进。

blocks.en:
While perhaps not as outspoken as Alex Karp, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella in July 2026 made similar arguments about AI sovereignty in what he calls the ‘‘Reverse Information Paradox’’. 35 35 35 https://x.com/satyanadella/status/2076323181154230284 He asserted that, with AI, organizations pay for intelligence twice, once with money, and again with something even more valuable: proprietary knowledge that an organization must reveal to make that intelligence useful.
Over time, model providers learn about their customers (via prompts, confidential information, agent tools, human feedback, usage statistics, etc.), making it imperative for organizations to establish a trust boundary to prevent misappropriation.
Nadella actually cites Karp, saying that organizations “want to know they own the means of production, and it’s not being transferred to someone else”.
blocks.zh:
微软首席执行官Satya Nadella在2026年7月虽然可能不像Alex Karp那样直言不讳,但他在所谓的“反向信息Paradox”中就AI主权提出了类似的论点。 他断言,与大赦国际一起,各组织为情报支付两次费用,一次用钱支付,另一次用更有价值的东西支付:一个组织必须披露的专有知识,使情报有用。
随着时间的推移,模型提供者了解其客户(通过提示、保密信息、代理工具、人类反馈、使用统计等),因此各组织必须建立信托边界,防止挪用。
Nadella实际上引用了Karp, 说组织“想知道自己拥有生产资料,

blocks.en:
Our work is very much inspired by this line of thinking, and we share concerns about institutional autonomy.
To this discussion, we additionally contribute two less frequently mentioned issues from the academic perspective: the important role of transparency in developing a rigorous understanding of model behavior and the valuable educational opportunities that arise from the ability to build fully open and sovereign models (Section 3.5 ).
From a technical perspective, we focus specifically on the transparency and reproducibility of model development, including access to the data and recipes needed to independently build various artifacts.
We make available everything necessary for an organization to reproduce our results, to inspect each step in the pipeline, and to make any modifications as necessary.
Our contribution is to demonstrate what can be achieved with limited computational resources in a fully open and sovereign manner.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作非常受这种思路的启发,我们也对体制自治感到关切。
在本次讨论中,我们还从学术角度提出了两个不太经常提到的问题:透明度在严格理解示范行为方面的重要作用,以及建立完全开放和主权模式的能力所产生的宝贵的教育机会(第3.5节)。
从技术角度看,我们具体侧重于模型开发的透明度和可复制性,包括获取独立建造各种文物所需的数据和食谱。
我们为一个组织提供一切必要的条件,以复制我们的成果,检查管道中的每一个步骤,并作出必要的修改。
我们的贡献是以充分开放和主权的方式展示有限的计算资源所能实现的目标。

blocks.en: 8.2 Open Models and Related Efforts
blocks.zh: 8.2 开放模式和相关努力

blocks.en: We compare the goals of Project Greenhouse and our current contributions to a representative selection of other open models and related efforts.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了 " 温室项目 " 的目标以及我们目前对有代表性的其他开放模式和相关努力的贡献。

blocks.en:
Building on earlier open efforts such as BLOOM ( BigScience Workshop, 2022 ) and Pythia ( Biderman et al., 2023 ) , AI2 announced the OLMo (Open Language Model) project in May 2023. 36 36 36 Announcing AI2 OLMo, an Open Language Model Made by Scientists, for Scientists. The goal was to develop fully open language models to benefit the research community by providing access for scientific study and education around all aspects of model creation.
AI2 accomplished this by releasing not only model checkpoints, but also training data, code, and evaluation resources.
The first OLMo models were released in February 2024 ( Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) , followed by OLMo 2 in November 2024 ( Team OLMo, 2024 ) and Olmo 3 in November 2025 ( Team Olmo, 2025 ) .
This seminal line of work has provided an important reference point for open research in building language models and establishes an important foundation for our approach: transparency throughout model development enables independent experimentation, reproducibility, and rigorous understanding.
blocks.zh:
在早先的开放努力,如BLOOM(大科学讲习班,2022年)和Pythia(Biderman等,2023年)的基础上,AI2于2023年5月宣布了OLMo(开放语言模型)项目. 36 36 Announcing AI2 OLMo,由科学家为科学家制作的开放语言模型. 目标是开发完全开放的语言模型,为研究界带来好处,提供围绕模型创建各个方面进行科学研究和教育的机会.
AI2为此不仅发布了示范检查站,而且还发布了培训数据、代码和评价资源。
2024年2月发布了首个OLMo模型(Groeneveld等,2024年),后又于2024年11月发布了OLMo 2 (Team OLMo,2024年)和2025年11月发布了Olmo 3 (Team Olmo,2025年).
这一开创性的工作路线为建设语言模型的公开研究提供了一个重要的参考点,为我们的方法奠定了重要的基础:整个模型开发过程的透明度使得能够进行独立的实验、复制和严格的理解。

blocks.en:
Nevertheless, there are important differences between the OLMo project and our efforts: OLMo aspires to be a family of state-of-the-art models with a diverse set of capabilities, including long-context reasoning, function calling, coding, instruction following, general chat, and knowledge recall.
In contrast, our ambitions are much more tightly scoped, focused only on agentic search.
Due to its frontier aspirations, OLMo required far more compute than typically available to academic institutions:
The developers reported approximately 56 days from the start of training to the evaluation of Olmo 3 Think 32B on a cluster with 1,024 H100 GPUs ( Team Olmo, 2025 ) .
The model was pre-trained on roughly 6T tokens, approximately 20 × \times larger than our corpus.
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,OLMo项目与我们的努力之间仍有重大差异: OLMo渴望成为拥有多种能力的一流模式的家族,包括长文推理,函数调用,编码,教导跟随,通俗聊天,以及知识回想等.
相比之下,我们的雄心壮志范围要严格得多,只专注于代理搜索.
由于其疆界愿望,法律厅比学术机构通常更需要计算:
开发商报告,从培训开始到评价Olmo 3 Think 32B, 大约56天的时间,
模型是预先训练的 大约6T个符牌, 大约20xx\时间 比我们的命案。

blocks.en:
Despite this transparency, reproducing the larger OLMo models from scratch remains beyond the resources of most individual research groups.
In contrast, our reranker models are far more restricted in capability but can be reproduced using only a handful of GPUs.
We therefore view our efforts as complementary: alongside transparency in how models are developed, we emphasize making end-to-end experimentation practical under modest compute budgets.
This accessibility matters because researchers need to do more than reproduce a single checkpoint; they must also be able to modify the data, test alternative recipes, and run controlled ablations.
blocks.zh:
尽管有这种透明度,从零开始复制更大的OLMO模型仍然超出了大多数个别研究团体的资源范围.
相比之下,我们的再排名模型在能力上受到更严格的限制,但只能使用少数GPU来复制.
因此,我们认为我们的努力是相辅相成的:除了在如何制定模型方面保持透明度外,我们强调在微薄的计算预算下使端到端试验切实可行。
这种可访问性很重要,因为研究人员需要做的不仅仅是复制一个检查站;他们还必须能够修改数据、测试替代食谱并运行受控的烟雾。

blocks.en:
Tülu is a complementary project ( Lambert et al., 2024 ) , also by AI2, that focuses on open post-training methods for existing models.
The effort partially overlaps with the OLMo project and its recipes informed the development of instruction-following OLMo models.
For example, Tülu 3 builds on Llama 3.1 base models, with releases that include data, code, and recipes used for post-training.
DR Tulu ( Shao et al., 2026 ) is an agentic search model directly trained for open-ended, long-form deep research.
Starting from Qwen3-8B, the authors performed supervised fine-tuning on research trajectories, including examples generated from GPT-5, followed by reinforcement learning with evolving rubrics (RLER).
These rubrics incorporate retrieved evidence and are updated using the model’s rollouts, allowing the evaluation criteria to adapt to newly discovered information.
The project released model weights, training data, code, and search-agent infrastructure.
blocks.zh:
Tülu是一个补充项目(Lambert等,2024年),也是由AI2进行,其重点是对现有模式的开放后培训方法.
这项工作与OLMo项目部分重叠,其配方为开发遵循OLMo的教学模型提供了参考。
譬如说. Tülu 3基于Llama 3.1的基础模型,其发布内容包括数据,代码,以及用于后培训的食谱.
DR Tulu(Shao等,2026年)是直接被训练用于可开阔,长型深层研究的代理搜索模型.
从Qune3-8B开始,作者对研究轨迹进行了有监督的微调,包括由GPT-5生成的例子,再用演化的标点进行强化学习(RLER).
这些主题包括所取出的证据,并利用模型的推出加以更新,使评价标准能够适应新发现的信息。
该项目发布了模型权重、培训数据、代码和搜索代理基础设施。

blocks.en:
While DR Tulu shares some of the same end goals as our efforts, there are substantial differences in scope and approach.
Project Greenhouse aspires to tackle agentic search in its entirety (which includes deep research), but our approach is more incremental: we plan to develop and evaluate specific capabilities before integrating them into more complex systems.
Our first milestone is a pointwise reranker, which is far less ambitious in scope than DR Tulu.
However, we require that the resulting models be fully open and sovereign under our definition.
Although DR Tulu makes its agent-training pipeline available, it begins with an open-weight backbone whose pre-training data and recipes are not fully available.
Thus, it does not qualify as fully open and sovereign under our definition.
We will not repeat arguments for why we feel that open-weight models are not enough, but see Section 3.4 for the organizational perspective and Section 3.5 for the academic perspective.
blocks.zh:
DR时 图卢同我们的努力有着一些相同的最终目标,在范围和方法上存在着很大的差异。
" 温室项目 " 希望全面解决代理搜索问题(包括深入研究),但我们的方法更加渐进:我们计划发展和评价具体能力,然后将其纳入更复杂的系统。
我们的第一个里程碑是一个有分寸的重排,其范围远不如Tulu博士的宏大。
然而,根据我们的定义,我们要求由此产生的模式是完全开放和主权的。
虽然DR Tulu提供其代理培训管道,它从开放式骨干开始,其培训前数据和食谱不完全可用。
因此,根据我们的定义,它并不完全开放和主权。
我们不重复为什么我们感到开放加权模式还不够的论点,但组织观点见第3.4节,学术观点见第3.5节。

blocks.en:
The purpose of the Marin project is the discovery and promulgation of the ‘‘process knowledge’’ necessary to create frontier-level artificial intelligence. 37 37 37 Open Development of Frontier AI. It originated at Stanford University in 2024, but the Marin models are now primarily developed by Open Athena, a nonprofit that accelerates academia with capabilities from the AI frontier, with community contributions. 38 38 38 Marin project website. According to the Marin website, “open” means that everything is shared: all discussions, all code, including models, infrastructure, etc., model weights, the sources of all the data in the training corpus, the results of successful and unsuccessful experiments, and tools that make it easy to learn from this effort.
As of October 2026, the project is training a mixture-of-experts model with 535 billion parameters total, 23 billion parameters active, on 18 trillion tokens of data.
blocks.zh:
马林项目的目的是发现和颁布建立前沿人工智能所必需的“过程知识”。 它起源于2024年的斯坦福大学,但马林模型现在主要由Open Athena开发出,这个非营利组织从AI前沿加速了拥有能力的学术界,社区贡献. 38 38 38 三十八马林项目网站. 根据马林网站,"开放"意味着一切是共享的:所有讨论,所有代码,包括模型,基础设施等,模型权重,培训大纲中所有数据的来源,成功和不成功的实验结果,以及便于从这一努力中学习的工具.
截至2026年10月,该项目正在培训一个专家混合模型,该模型的参数总数为5 350亿个,有230亿个参数在活动,涉及18万亿个符号的数据。

blocks.en:
Marin articulates a laudable vision of model development, but Project Greenhouse differs in several important respects.
Whereas Marin explicitly aims for frontier-level intelligence, we have far more tightly scoped ambitions focused on agentic search.
Aiming for the frontier requires substantial centralized computational resources; for example, the hero run referenced above is being trained on 11 × \times GB200 NVL72 racks.
In contrast, our approach allows for more decentralization, as most individual experiments described in this paper can be reproduced with only one or two GPUs.
Thus, we view our efforts as complementary, but sharing the same goal of expanding public knowledge.
blocks.zh:
马林阐述了值得称赞的模型开发愿景,但温室项目在几个重要方面有所不同.
虽然Marin明确的目标是边境情报,但我们更严格地将目标集中在特工搜索上。
瞄准边疆需要大量的集中计算资源;例如,上面提到的英雄跑道正在接受11 ×\times GB200 NVL72架上的培训.
相反,我们的方法允许更多的权力下放,因为本文件所描述的大多数个别实验只能用一两个GPU复制.
因此,我们认为我们的努力是相辅相成的,但有着扩大公共知识的共同目标。

blocks.en:
In August 2026, Chen et al. (2026) contributed to the sovereign AI discussion through Thomson, a new general-purpose frontier model family trained with an enhanced focus on high-stakes professional work.
Although not technically open by our definition, discussions of sovereignty figured prominently in the narrative around the model and its associated technical report, making a focused discussion of the Thomson effort worthwhile.
The research team demonstrated that frontier performance is achievable by a wide range of institutions through continual learning on existing open-weight models (specifically, Qwen3.6-35B and Qwen3.5-397B).
Model weights for the small 35B variant of Thomson are publicly available.
blocks.zh:
2026年8月,陈等(2026年)通过汤姆森为主权AI讨论出力,汤姆森是一个新的通用前沿模范家庭,受到更注重高考专业工作的训练.
尽管我们的定义在技术上并不开放,但关于主权的讨论在该模式及其相关技术报告的说明中占有显著地位,因此值得对汤姆森的努力进行有重点的讨论。
研究小组表明,通过不断学习现有的开放加权模式(特别是Qune3.6-35B和Qune3.5-397B),广泛的机构可以实现前沿绩效。
汤姆森35B型小变种的模型权重被公开取出.

blocks.en:
While we share their emphasis on institutional autonomy and on making model development transparent, there are several important differences between the Thomson effort and Project Greenhouse.
Again, like Marin and OLMo discussed above, Thomson aims for the frontier, which we do not.
However, instead of starting “from scratch”, i.e., from pre-training, Thomson starts from Qwen open-weight models.
Thus, the model does not meet our definition of fully open and sovereign as upstream details remain unavailable.
In working with Qwen as a starting point, the Thomson researchers expended considerable effort in “value re-alignment” before they could proceed with continued pre-training to focus on desired capabilities.
Furthermore, the resources required for their efforts are beyond most organizations: the model family was “developed by a technical team not exceeding three dozen engineers and scientists on a modest compute cluster with no more than 368 B200 GPUs available at any stage of experimentation”.
While the project represents an important example of a viable alternative approach, its resource requirements remain beyond the budget of most academic institutions.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们同意他们强调机构自主和使示范发展具有透明度,但汤姆森努力和温室项目之间有好几项重要的区别。
同样,正如上面讨论的马林和OLMo,汤姆森的目标是边界,我们没有。
然而,汤姆森不是从“从零开始”,即从培训前开始,而是从Quen开放量级模型开始。
因此,这一模式不符合我们关于完全开放和主权的定义,因为上游细节仍然不可用。
作为起点,汤姆森研究人员在与Quen合作时在“价值调整”方面付出了相当大的努力,然后才能继续接受以预期能力为重点的前期培训。
此外,他们的努力所需的资源超出了大多数组织的范围:模范家族是“一个由不超过三打的工程师和科学家组成的技术小组在一个简单的计算集群上开发的,在任何试验阶段都不超过368个B200GPU”。
虽然该项目是可行的替代办法的一个重要例子,但其所需资源仍然超出大多数学术机构的预算。

blocks.en:
The discussions above focus on prominent, high-profile efforts, but researchers have released many open models over the years.
Earlier contributions to transparent model development include LLM360’s Amber and CrystalCoder in 2023 ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , followed by MAP-Neo ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and DCLM ( Li et al., 2024 ) in 2024, which made training data and development artifacts available alongside model weights.
blocks.zh:
以上讨论的重点是突出的,高调的努力,但研究人员多年来发布了许多公开的模型.
早期对透明模型开发的贡献包括2023年LLM360的"琥珀"和"Crystal Coder"(Liu等,2023年)等,而后于2024年由MAP-Neo(Zhang等,2024年)和DCLM(Li等,2024年)相继提供培训数据和发展文物并配有模型权重.

blocks.en:
Subsequent efforts have pursued several complementary directions: SmolLM ( Allal et al., 2025 ) emphasizes small models and transparent training recipes, while Comma, introduced with Common Pile in 2025 ( Kandpal et al., 2025 ) , emphasizes public-domain and openly licensed training data.
Continuing development is evident in LLM360’s subsequent K2 models ( K2 Team, 2025 ) , the expanding Pleias family ( Langlais et al., 2025 ) , including Baguettotron, and multilingual initiatives such as Apertus ( Project Apertus, 2025 ) and EuroLLM ( Ramos et al., 2026 ) , with further releases and technical reports appearing in 2025–2026.
Most recently, Gensyn’s Open-1B ( Donaghy et al., 2026 ) , announced in September 2026, explores independently auditable training through the release of data, checkpoints, and a framework for replaying individual training steps. 39 39 39 However, its dependence on an unreleased operator-library prevents us from considering the effort fully open.
blocks.zh:
其后的努力追求了若干相辅相成的方向:SmolLM(Allal等,2025年)强调小型模式和透明培训配方,而Comma则在2025年与Common Pile(Kandpal等,2025年)一同推出,强调公共领域和公开许可的培训数据.
LLM360随后的K2模型(K2 Team,2025年),正在扩展的Pleias家族(Langlais等,2025年),包括Baguetotron,以及Apertus(项目Apertus,2025年)和EuroLLM(Ramos等,2026年)等多语种倡议都显示出来,进一步发布和技术报告出现在2025-2026年。
最近,在2026年9月宣布的Gensyn的Open-1B(Donaghy等,2026年)通过发布数据、检查点和重放个人培训步骤的框架,探索了可独立审计的培训。 但是,它依赖于一个未释放的操作员-图书馆,使我们无法考虑完全开放的努力。

blocks.en:
While there are many open-weight models (too numerous to enumerate), the Qwen family of models ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Qwen Team, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026b ) deserves special recognition as the starting point most commonly used by information retrieval researchers.
However, as we have argued throughout this report, the availability of model weights is insufficient from both the perspective of organizational control and academic transparency.
blocks.zh:
虽然有许多开放量级模型(数量太多,无法列举),但昆文家族模型(杨等,2024;张等,2025b;克文团队,2026a;克文团队,2026b)作为信息检索研究者最常用的起点,值得特别认可.
然而,正如我们在整个报告中所指出,从组织控制和学术透明度的角度来看,模型权重不足。

blocks.en:
In part as a reaction to the sovereignty considerations discussed throughout this report,
organizations are increasingly adapting models to their own tasks, seeking better performance, lower costs, and greater control over model behavior.
These efforts share the common theme of attempting to reduce dependence on proprietary frontier models by substituting open-weight backbones.
blocks.zh:
部分是对本报告所讨论的主权考虑的反应,
各组织越来越多地根据自己的任务调整模型,寻求更好的业绩,降低成本,加强对模型行为的控制.
这些努力的共同主题是试图通过取而代之的开放式骨干来减少对专利前沿模型的依赖。

blocks.en: A blog post in June 2026 shared details on a collaboration between Thinking Machines and Bridgewater AIA Labs to build small models that capture human expertise on six information filtering tasks. 40 40 40 Learning to Replicate Expert Judgment in Financial Tasks Not surprisingly, they demonstrated that small custom task-specific models, fine-tuned on high-quality proprietary datasets labeled by expert investors, can exceed frontier performance.
blocks.zh: 2026年6月的一则博客文章分享了思考机器与布里奇沃特AIA Labs合作建立小模型的细节,这些模型可以捕捉人类在六项信息过滤任务上的专门知识. 40 40 40 Learning to Try Enterpress in Financial Asks 不足为奇的是,它们表明,对专家投资者贴上标签的高质量专有数据集进行微调的小型定制任务专用模型可能超过前沿性能。

blocks.en:
The legal AI startup Harvey introduced in August 2026 their Tenet model, 41 41 41 Harvey Tenet Research Preview post-trained from a Kimi K3 base in collaboration with Fireworks research for long-horizon legal work.
The blog post indicated promising results for both performance and cost-efficiency, and significant gains on complex, document-intensive tasks like M&A Diligence.
The company followed up in September 2026 with another blog post 42 42 42 Post-Training RLM Agents for End-to-End M&A Diligence about training a recursive language model ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) harness in collaboration with Baseten.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Don’t like this work?
Or perhaps there are too many limitations?
We’ll pre-empt criticisms in the form of anticipated objections in an attempt to self-own:
blocks.zh:
不喜欢这部作品?
或者也许有太多的限制?

blocks.en:
Yes, the often-used criticism and the favorite of reviewer 2.
Project Greenhouse lays out an overall vision and in this report we deliver on the first project milestone.
We concede that there is nothing particularly novel about each of our steps, which build on well-known methods from the literature, except that to our knowledge, we are the first to have put everything together in this way.
blocks.zh:
是的,经常使用的批评和评论员2的最爱。
" 温室项目 " 提出了总体设想,我们在本报告中提出了第一个项目里程碑。
我们承认,我们的每一步都没有什么特别新颖的,这些步骤都是以文献中众所周知的方法为基础的,但据我们所知,我们是首先以这种方式把一切放在一起的。

blocks.en:
Yes, it could indeed be the case that reranking is too easy for any modern LLM, and this is why we are able to demonstrate competitive effectiveness with such a simple two-step recipe.
Even if true, this finding is entirely orthogonal to the claims we make in this paper, which is focused on building fully open and sovereign models.
We believe that our goals are possible with limited computational resources, which dictates the model sizes that we can practically explore.
The fact that competitive rerankers are possible using small models is not inconsistent with our core thesis.
We will follow up with additional explorations to better characterize the interplay between model size and task difficulty.
blocks.zh:
的确,对于任何现代的LLM来说,重新排序都太容易了,这就是为什么我们能够用这样一个简单的分两步走的办法来显示竞争效力的原因。
即便如此,这一结论与我们在本文中提出的要求完全正统,该文件的重点是建立完全开放和主权的模式。
我们认为,在有限的计算资源下,我们的目标是可以实现的,这决定了我们可以实际探索的模型大小。
使用小型模型可以进行竞争性的再排名,这与我们的核心论文并不矛盾.
我们将进行更多的探索,以更好地说明模型规模与任务难度之间的相互作用。

blocks.en: While we have demonstrated the viability of fully open and sovereign models for reranking, it might be the case that the full suite of agentic capabilities is beyond what can be achieved in a fully open and sovereign manner with limited computational resources. 44 44 44 Although evidence from Shao et al. (2026) might suggest otherwise. In other words, a competitive reranker does not establish a path to a competitive agent.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们已经证明完全开放和主权模式可以重新排列,但可能情况是,全套代理能力已经超出了以完全开放和主权的方式在有限的计算资源下实现的能力。 44 44 44,虽然Shao等人(2026年)提供的证据可能表明情况并非如此。 换句话说,竞争性的重新排名者不会建立通往竞争性代理人的道路.

blocks.en:
Note that as discussed in Section 2 , we do not prescribe any particular architecture, and it could be the case that non-open and non-sovereign models are still needed for at least some aspects of agentic search.
For example, a frontier or near-frontier model might still be necessary for overall coordination, while delegating other aspects of search to smaller open and sovereign models.
If this is the case, our core thesis will not be fully validated.
This may very well be true, but we won’t know unless we try—and along the way, we’re sure much will be learned.
We’ll try it and report back.
blocks.zh:
请注意,正如第2节所讨论,我们没有规定任何特定的架构,而且至少对于代理搜索的某些方面,仍然需要非开放和非主权模式。
例如,边界或近边界模式对于全面协调可能仍然必要,同时将搜索的其他方面交给较小的开放和主权模式。
如果是这样的话,我们的核心论文将不会得到充分验证。
但除非我们尝试, 否则我们不会知道,
我们会尝试,

blocks.en:
Based on our model of LLM training as hypergraph traversal (Section 3 ), we defined sovereignty in terms of tracing provenance to publicly available datasets such as ClimbMix ( Diao et al., 2025 ) and RLHN-250K ( Thakur et al., 2025 ) .
As we conceded, this is based on judgment, but we might be criticized for drawing arbitrary boundaries.
For example, datasets can contain undisclosed filtering, synthetic generation, annotation decisions, and dependencies on other models.
blocks.zh:
根据我们的LLM训练模式,我们界定了主权,即追踪C攀登Mix(Diao等,2025年)和RLHN-250K(Thakur等,2025年)等公开数据集的来源。
正如我们承认的那样,这是基于判断的,但我们可能会被批评为划定了武断的界限。
例如,数据集可以包含未公开的过滤,合成生成,注释决定,以及依赖其他模型.

blocks.en:
A skeptical reader could ask why treating a dataset as a trusted starting point is acceptable while treating a model checkpoint that way is not.
We argue that this distinction is defensible because access to individual training instances permits inspection and removal, which is not possible with access to model weights alone.
Perhaps a refinement of our sovereignty claim is the necessity of explicitly declaring provenance boundaries.
blocks.zh:
一个持怀疑态度的读者可能会问,为什么把一个数据集当作一个可信赖的起点是可以接受的,而把一个模式检查点当作不是这样的。
我们认为,这种区分是站得住脚的,因为获得个别培训的机会可以进行检查和清除,而光是获得模型加权量是不可能的。
也许,完善我们的主权主张是明确宣布出处边界的必要性。

blocks.en:
While we have argued that open-weight models are not sufficient to achieve our goals, these arguments do not necessitate our specific development path, specifically, pre-training our own backbone from scratch (Section 5 ).
Fine-tuning an existing small, fully open backbone might provide the same upstream transparency and perhaps better effectiveness or lower development cost.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们主张开放量度模式不足以实现我们的目标,但这些论点并不需要我们的具体发展道路,特别是从头开始预先培训我们自己的骨干(第5节)。
调整现有的、完全开放的小型主干线,可以提供同样的上游透明度,或许提高效力或降低发展成本。

blocks.en:
This may perhaps be the case, but we make several important counterpoints:
Our claims primarily center around providing an “existence proof” of what’s possible (i.e., sufficiency); we never claimed that our path is uniquely necessary.
From the perspective of reproducibility and pedagogy, however, it was desirable for us to pre-train a backbone from scratch: the backbone described in Section 5 is simply what we ended up with.
Indeed, it would be interesting future work to extend the experiments in Section 7.1 to include other open backbones.
blocks.zh:
也许是这样,但我们提出了一些重要的反点:
我们的主张主要围绕着提供可能(即充分性)的“存在证据 ” ; 我们从未声称我们的路径是独一无二的。
然而,从可复制性和教学学的角度来看,我们最好从零开始预先培训骨干:第5节所描述的骨干只是我们最后的成果。
实际上,今后将第7.1节中的试验扩大到包括其他开放骨干将是令人感兴趣的。

blocks.en:
Yes, indeed.
There are many data and training conditions that we did not have time to explore and document in this report.
We attempted to strike a balance between velocity and achieving our milestone objective, separating the experiments that are necessary to support our claims from the “nice to have” interesting extensions.
Of course, more experiments can improve our understanding of LLM behavior.
However, we believe that our headline result provides a small step in demonstrating the veracity of our core thesis.
We invite the community to contribute to our efforts and believe that our hypergraph model of LLM training provides a lightweight mechanism for coordinating experimental activity across diverse research groups around the world.
blocks.zh:
是的,确实。
有许多数据和培训条件,我们没有时间在本报告中加以探讨和记录。
我们试图在速度与实现我们的里程碑目标之间取得平衡,将支持我们的要求所必要的实验与“最好有”有趣的扩展分开。
当然,更多的实验可以增进我们对LLM行为的理解.
然而,我们认为,我们的头条成果在表明我们的核心论点的真实性方面迈出了一小步。
我们邀请社区为我们的努力出力,并认为我们的LLM训练超图模型为协调世界各地不同研究团体的实验活动提供了一个轻量级的机制。

blocks.en:
Perhaps.
While some of our experiments can be considered out of domain (see Section 4.1 ), they are not as thorough as we would have liked, and this is an admitted weakness of our present results.
However, this limitation does not detract from the central claims in this report about model openness and sovereignty.
The standard tricks that the community has developed to promote generalization and guard against overfitting remain applicable to our training pipeline, and there is no reason why we can’t also adopt those techniques.
We will follow up in subsequent work to explicitly explore this question of out-of-domain generalization and report back.
blocks.zh:
也许吧
虽然我们的一些实验可以被认为是超出范畴的(见第4.1节),但这些实验并不像我们所希望的那样彻底,这是我们目前成果的一个公认的弱点.
然而,这一限制并不减损本报告关于模式开放和主权的中央要求。
社区为推广普及和防范过度适应而开发出的标准花招仍适用于我们的训练管道,
我们将在今后的工作中采取后续行动,明确探讨这个领域外的概括问题并作出汇报。

blocks.en:
A provider of proprietary or non-sovereign models can always distill down to whatever model size and scope of capabilities that we’re targeting.
In that way, we will always be dominated along the Pareto frontier and will never achieve “best in class” status.
This is likely true, but our objective was never to “win”.
Our thesis centers on demonstrating capabilities in a fully open and sovereign manner, with the bar of achieving “competitive” effectiveness (as opposed to achieving the state of the art).
In this way, our models will support something that no proprietary or non-sovereign model can: transparency and the rigorous understanding that comes along with it.
blocks.zh:
一个专有或非主权模型的提供者总是可以分解到我们所瞄准的模型大小和能力范围。
这样,我们将永远在帕雷托边界一带占主导地位,永远不会取得“最佳阶级”地位。
这很可能是真的,但我们的目标绝不是“取胜”。
我们的论文以充分开放和主权的方式展示能力为中心,以达到“竞争”效果为障碍(而不是达到最新水平)。
这样,我们的模型将支持没有任何专有或非主权模型能够做到的东西:透明度和随之而来的严格理解。

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10 结论

blocks.en:
Project Greenhouse intends to be an ongoing, long-term project and this report lays out our goals at a high level, including arguments on why we believe our efforts are important and potentially impactful.
Our goals are ambitious but, we feel, achievable, and here we deliver the first project milestone.
We describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker with a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch and supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets.
As we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, we are fully in control of model training, from end to end.
The modest computational requirements of our experiments mean that it is feasible for others to reproduce and to build on our results.
blocks.zh:
" 温室项目 " 打算是一个持续的长期项目,本报告在高级别上阐述了我们的目标,包括为什么我们认为我们的努力是重要的和可能产生影响的论点。
我们的目标是雄心勃勃的,但我们认为是可以实现的,我们在这里提出了第一个项目里程碑。
我们描述了如何用简单的两步制配方构建一个具有竞争性的有分点的解码器再排行榜,包括从头开始的预训和有监督的微调,只从通常可用的数据集开始。
由于我们不依赖第三方现有的开放重量骨干,我们完全控制模式培训,从头到尾。
我们实验的微小的计算要求意味着,其他人可以复制和借鉴我们的结果。

blocks.en:
The path forward is clear for us: having laid out our vision and delivered the first project milestone, we’ll simply continue and do what we said we would.
We extend an invitation for other like-minded academic research groups, organizations, and independent researchers to join us on our journey.
Otherwise, stay tuned for the next installment!

blocks.en:
For each training instance, we sampled one positive passage and K K hard negatives from the query’s available passages.
We chose K K as the largest value in { 7 , 15 , 23 } \{7,15,23\} supported by its negative pool.
Of the 247,534 baseline instances, 1.93% used seven negatives, 45.85% used 15, and 52.21% used 23, forming groups of 8, 16, or 24 query–passage pairs.
Instances were bucketed by K K so that each microbatch contained groups of the same size.
Each group contributed one contrastive loss, computed jointly over its positive and sampled negatives.
blocks.zh:
每一次培训,我们从查询中抽取了1个正段落和K K硬底段落。
我们选择了 K K 作为最大值 在 { 7, 15, 23} 中,
在247,534个基线实例中,1.93%使用了7个底片,45.85%使用了15个底片,52.21%使用了23个底片,组成了8个16个组,即24个查询-通过对。
实例被K K 所桶装,因此每个微批都包含大小相同的组.
每一组都造成了一个对比性损失,按其正负和抽样负负数共同计算。

blocks.en:
Within each bucket, we packed complete query groups into per-GPU microbatches, padding the query–passage sequences to the longest sequence in the microbatch.
Packing was limited by both an estimated padded-token budget and a group-count cap.
Token estimates included the prompt, query and passage lengths, and a 30% safety margin.
The token budget accounted for GPU memory reserved for model parameters, gradients, and optimizer states, with a cap of 60,000 estimated tokens per GPU.
Baseline runs 1, 3, and 4 used microbatch budgets of 39,312 tokens per GPU; run 2 used 39,347.
Microbatches contained at most 64, 32, or 21 query groups for K = 7 K=7 , 15, or 23, respectively, limiting them to approximately 512 query–passage sequences.
blocks.zh:
在每桶内,我们把完整的查询组打入了每个GPU的微信箱,将查询 - 通道序列固定到微信箱中最长的序列.
包装受到估计的加价预算和组数上限的限制。
Token估计包括了快速、查询和通道长度以及30%的安全幅度。
符号预算核算了为模型参数,梯度,和优化状态所保留的GPU内存,上限为每GPU6万个估计符.
基线为1,3和4个用过的微批预算,每个GPU39,312个令牌;运行2个使用了39,347.
K = 7 K = 7、15 或 23 的微信箱分别包含最多64个、32个或21个查询组,将其限制在大约512个查询-通过序列。

blocks.en:
Gradient accumulation across microbatches and GPUs targeted an effective batch of 128 query groups per optimizer update.
When a single group exceeded the microbatch budget, gradient caching processed its sequences in smaller chunks while retaining the joint LCE loss over all candidates.
Baseline run 4 retained run 1’s packing plan and used gradient caching with execution chunks of up to 16,384 tokens on its H100 GPUs.

当单个群体超过微批预算时,梯度缓存以更小的块处理其序列,同时保留所有候选人的LCE联合损失.
基线运行 4 保留运行 1 的包装计划,并在其H100 GPU上使用有可达16 384个代币的梯度缓冲。

blocks.en:
Unless specified otherwise, we fine-tuned all retained parameters for one epoch using AdamW [ Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ] with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , weight decay of 0.01, and gradient clipping at a global norm of 12.
The learning rate increased linearly for 150 steps and then followed a cosine decay to zero at the final update.
Baseline run 1 used seed 17 and 1,931 updates.
Baseline training used two GPUs with gradient checkpointing.

blocks.en:
We used a common optimization recipe and changed the factors specified by each experiment.
Apart from the diagnostic learning-rate comparison for Gemma and MiniCPM reported in Section 7.1 , we did not perform hyperparameter tuning.
The comparisons characterize effectiveness under this common recipe.

除了第7.1节所报告的Gemma和MiniCPM的诊断学习率比较之外,我们没有进行超参数调试。
比较是这种共同办法下的效力的特点。

blocks.en:
All SFT comparisons used top-100 BM25 candidates and nDCG@10, with means computed separately over TREC Deep Learning 2019–2023 and the seven BEIR collections (TREC-COVID, TREC-News, Robust04, NFCorpus, SciFact, SCIDOCS, and FiQA).
The four baseline runs were evaluated using the same harness and inputs as the soup checkpoint.
Table 11 records training and evaluation precision in one place.
